categories.title: Bounty Poster
categories.info: Check inside jails, police stations, and sheriff offices for posters of wanted criminals in the area.

categories.title: Cigarette Card
categories.info:
Decorative cards found in the open world or inside purchased Premium Cigarette packs. Duplicate cards can be sold to fences.

Complete each of the twelve card sets for additional rewards.

categories.title: Dinosaur Bone
categories.info: Help [Deborah MacGuiness](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=50) with her paleontological research by mailing the locations of dinosaur bones.

categories.title: Dreamcatcher
categories.info:
Keep an eye out for intricately woven ornaments hanging from tree branches.

Find all Dreamcatchers to reveal a clue on the map that points to a [secret treasure!](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=5383.)

categories.title: Grave
categories.info: Visit all graves to unlock the Paying Respects trophy / achievement.

categories.title: Item Request
categories.info: Deliver 5 requested items to unlock the Errand Boy trophy / achievement. The items will spawn regardless of progression, but the gang will only request them during certain chapters.

categories.title: Legendary Animal
categories.info:
Test your hunting skills by tracking down unique wildlife. Their pelts can be traded to Trappers to unlock cosmetics and gear; animal parts can be traded to Fences for talismans.

Within the designated area, interact with all yellow clues to reveal the animal's precise location. Before searching, make sure you receive the following on-screen message: *“You have entered Legendary Animal Territory. Hunt this Legendary Animal by finding and inspecting clues”.*

locations.title: Hunting Request #1
locations.description:
**Starting Location:** Valentine Post Office (Check the posters)  

**Required Animals:**  
1 x Perfect Squirrel Carcass  
1 x Perfect Rabbit Carcass  

**Recommended Weapon:** Small game arrows or Varmint Rifle  
**Reward:** $50

**Reward:** $70

locations.title: Hunting Request #5
locations.description:
**Starting Location:** Van Horn Post Office (Check the posters)  - Available from Epilogue 1  

**Required Animals:**  
1 x Perfect Cedar Waxwing Carcass  
1 x Perfect Bat Carcass  
1 x Perfect Blue Jay Carcass  
1 x Perfect Crow Carcass  
1 x Perfect Beaver Carcass

**Recommended Weapon:** Small game arrows or Varmint Rifle / Standard arrows or Repeater Rifle (Beaver) 

**Reward:** $150 and an invite to meet Ms. Hobbs, who will give you the Squirrel Statue as a reward for completing all 5 hunting requests. Putting it on the mantelpiece in Beecher's Hope unlocks the trophy *It's Art*.

locations.title: Dutch - Pipe

locations.title: Legendary Smallmouth Bass
locations.description:
**Lure:** Special Lake Lure

**Advanced Reeling-In Technique:** When the fish is tired out, tilt Left Stick downward to pull your rod up and quickly reel it in. Repeat after a second or two - pull up and reel in. Repeat as often as possible until the fish starts struggling again.

locations.title: Meteor House
locations.description: This cabin has a hole in the roof where a meteorite has come through and killed the inhabitants.  The room is smoking and the bodies are burned.  Inside you can collect the meteorite.

locations.title: Strange Statues Cave
locations.description:
**Puzzle:** Each statue has a certain number of fingers. You need to push the buttons on the statues that have the number of fingers: 2, 3, 5 and 7 (prime numbers). 

One of the statues is missing an arm, which can be found in a pile of rocks in the corner of the cave. This statue will represent 7. If you accidentally press a button on an incorrect statue, you can push the button back out by pressing a button on the back of the statue. The order that you select does not matter. It's hard to see this button, so use Eagle Eye and first person view.

**Reward:** Gold Bar x3 (worth $1500 total!)

locations.title: Strange Statues - Painting
locations.description:
This area has a big rock formation with a hole in the middle of it.  Head into the circular opening in the big rock to inspect a painting.

Before or after discovering this painting, you can visit the [Strange Statues Cave](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=153) and solve its puzzle to earn three gold bars (which fetch a price of $500 each.)

locations.title: Giant Remains
locations.description: Follow the path south-east.  The skeleton is under a large overhanging rock, and above a rock carving.

locations.title: Pagan Ritual
locations.description: Home to the [Pagan Skull Mask](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=329) and a bottle of [Valerian Root](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=55497).

locations.title: Tiny Church
locations.description: A tiny church for a tiny congregation

locations.title: Hermit Woman
locations.description: A solitary woman living alone with several feral dogs. Some theorize that she moved to this location to become a witch.

locations.title: Native Burial Site
locations.description:
A [Stone Hatchet](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=370) can be found in the centre of its large stone circle.
If you start a fire in the center of the stone circle, it will start to rain.

locations.title: Face in Cliff
locations.description:
A Mount Rushmore-esque face carved into the mountain. Approach from the north to make it to the top. 

The sculptor has died by suicide and left a note which you can retrieve from his body - "Note from the Sculptor"

locations.title: Barrel Rider
locations.description: A thrill seeker went over Donner Falls in a barrel. It ended exactly how you'd expect.

locations.title: Crashed Airship
locations.description:
The wreckage of a flying machine with a corpse inside.

This may be an Easter Egg referencing the Kinnear family from Red Dead Redemption 1. Charles Kinnear creates an ill-fated flying machine in the 'Deadalus and Son' side mission, and another of his machines can be found in this game when exploring [New Austin](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=894).  

The wreck here _could_ be the work of Charles' brother Percival, as the corpse wears remarkably similar glasses to Charles.

locations.title: Manmade Mutant
locations.description:
A gruesome frankenstein experiment, made from various animal parts.


Enter the building by climbing through the window on the second floor, above the southwest porch.

locations.title: Oil Derrick
locations.description:
A letter from the vice president of Cornwall Kerosene & Tar can be found on the body by the Derrick, while [Dinosaur Bone #3](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=53) is inside it.

Ginseng Elixir can be found in the abandoned camp.

locations.title: Abandoned Trading Post
locations.description: Lift up one of the floor planks to reveal a hidden stash.

locations.title: Circus Wagons
locations.description: A fortune telling machine can be found inside the blue wagon.

locations.title: Bolger Glade
locations.description: Approach the cannons in the middle of the battlefield to add this POI to your journal.

locations.title: Donkey Lady
locations.description:
Inspect the corpse of a woman with a donkey skull tied to the wheel.

This is a reference to a glitch in the first Red Dead Redemption, where the game would spawn an NPC with the behaviour and face of a donkey. 

The glitch became popular after YouTube channel WhereDaBootz made [a video](https://youtu.be/7q7v4F8r9Og?si=Sxr_CjGACSl5iZ1L) showcasing the glitch.

locations.title: Flying Machine
locations.description:
The wreckage of a flying machine, with "Charles Kinnear" written on the back.

This references a character of the same name from the first Red Dead Redemption, who creates an ill-fated flying machine in the 'Deadalus and Son' side mission. The wreck here is likely to be the work of a younger Charles, who clearly did not improve his craft with age.

locations.title: Fossilized Man
locations.description: On a rock ledge, near the tunnel entrance

locations.title: Frozen Settler
locations.description: Wearing the [Morion Helmet](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=667).

locations.title: Gray's Secret
locations.description: On a porch. Only appears after completing the Chapter 3 mission "A Short Walk in a Pretty Town"

locations.title: Devil's Cave
locations.description: **NB:** You may need to enter and leave the cave to inspect it, where it will be added to your journal under the name 'Hidden Tunnel'.

locations.title: Jesuit Missionary
locations.description: Loot him for the [Letter to Brother Rodolfo](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=945691).

locations.title: Meditating Monk
locations.description: Seems to only appear at noon.

locations.title: Obelisk
locations.description:
A 3-sided stone obelisk mounted on a square stone. On the west side, a plaque is located that contains the date 1771 and the latin phrase, "Hora fugit, ne tardes" which translates to "The hour flees, don't be late", a popular motto often used on sun dials.

Pull the plaque off and you'll find a gold earring and another treasure map.

locations.title: Old World Scripts
locations.description:
Engraved on the boulder on top of the ledge. Roughly translates to:

_We Arrived By Boat Beautiful Land Gracious People We Left Them To Live In Peace_

locations.title: Phonograph
locations.description: Inside the houseboat

locations.title: Serpent Mound
locations.description: Climb up the watchtower to inspect the site.

locations.title: Old Tomb
locations.description: Home to a [Viking Hatchet](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=144), [Viking Helmet](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=145), and [Ancient Viking Comb](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=670).

locations.title: Trail Trees (I)
locations.description: On the right side of the road before the bridge.

locations.title: Warped Tree
locations.description: At the top of a hill, next to a grave.

locations.title: Whale Bones
locations.description: A set of whale bones found in Big Valley, West Elizabeth. You can find this site West of Owanjila, on a hill that overlooks the lake.

locations.title: Braithwaites' Secret
locations.description:
A physically deformed and mentally ill woman can be found locked inside this outhouse.

She's still there in the epilogue.

locations.title: Brush Fire
locations.description: Can be added to your journal by standing near the burnt wagon nearby.

locations.title: Register Rock
locations.description: Just off the trail (to the north) and to the left of the tree. A "register rock" is one with names carved into it. You can see some from the trail, but most are on the topside of the large rock.

locations.title: Mysterious Aztec Writing #5
locations.description: **Location:** In the alleyway, on the wall

locations.title: Mysterious Aztec Writing #3
locations.description: **Location:** On the wall in the alley.

locations.title: Mysterious Aztec Writing #1
locations.description: **Location:** Left hand side of the blue building on a wood pole in the water

locations.title: Mysterious Aztec Writing #6
locations.description: **Location:** On the roof.

locations.title: Painting in Cabin
locations.description:
Finished painting can only be seen in the epilogue. 

Note: It was previously believed that you needed 100% completion to inspect this location but this is not the case.

locations.title: Mysterious Aztec Writing #4
locations.description: **Location:** In the alley behind the general store - on the wall

locations.title: Mysterious Aztec Writing #2
locations.description: **Location:** On top of the mortuary

locations.title: Coal Mine Writing
locations.description:
At the bottom of the Annesburg coal mine, in the northwesternmost tunnel, carved into the wooden wall. It is added to the player's journal without comment, and serves as the unofficial start to the [Reed Cottage Treasure](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=665).


**North Bennet Flew**

**North Bennett Flue**

**Red Roof, Green Door**

**Brothers I’ll be poor no more.**



This clue is intended to lead the player to [Reed Cottage](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=30359), north of Annesburg, wherein the player should check the chimney to find the [Sketched Treasure Map](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=30359).

locations.title: Homestead Stash - Chez Porter
locations.description:
**Requirements**: Chapter 2

Climb up a ladder inside the barn to the above floor to find the stash box next to some hay stacks. The treasure box contains 2 x $50 and a jewelry bag. Be sure to loot everything else in the houses too.



Additional loot can be found in the barn if robbing the place with Javier - you'll find it by lingering around him until he asks you to help him move a crate.

locations.title: Homestead Stash - Aberdeen Pig Farm
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Chapter 2 onwards

When you arrive at the farm, there's a guy sitting on the porch who greets you. Greet him back, talk to him and follow him inside his house. Then rob the place. Also be sure to go back outside and enter the door at the southern side of the house. This lets you in the room with the stash. This door is closed until you have followed the guy inside his house. It’s a little lockbox with 2 x $20 inside, be sure to loot that alongside everything else in the house.

locations.title: Homestead Stash - Lonnie's Shack
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Chapter 2

Inside Lonnie's Shack there are 4 guys. Kill 3 of them but keep 1 alive. Aim your gun at the last surviving guy and threaten him. Then he tells you the location of the stash. This will be different depending on who is the last guy alive.

**Important**: Make a manual save beforehand.  If you don't interrogate the last guy, you can't pick up the stash.

locations.title: Homestead Stash - Van Horn Mansion
locations.description: Go here early in the game to find two residents inside. Enter at night time and you'll find two people sleeping on the lower floor. Steal the money from their table and loot everything else in the house.

locations.title: Homestead Stash - Catfish Jacksons
locations.description: This homestead is occupied by a father and son, though you'll sometimes only find the son inside. Look for the shotgun in the living room, and threaten the son to learn where the [stash](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=810) is.

locations.title: Homestead Stash - Watson's Cabin
locations.description:
In Watson's Cabin you find an old lady. Enter her house and use the ladder in the back to climb down into the cellar. Steal her [Semi-Automatic Shotgun](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=439453) and leave. 

Return to the cabin the next day, and you'll encounter the lady's four sons. Kill them all and a lockbox will now be available on the kitchen table that was previously not there. The lockbox is the secret stash and contains 1 x $73.

**Bonus:** Check the nightstand drawer for a Gold Earring.

locations.title: Homestead Stash - Willard's Rest
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Available after completing the first story mission in Chapter 6

Talk to the resident here and teach her how to hunt. Return 2 days later. When you return, have a shooting contest with her and then you can loot her lockbox. Be sure to loot everything else too.

locations.title: Shop Robbery: Rhodes Gunsmith
locations.description:
Talk to the trapped man through the basement window of the Gunsmith. Once he tells you his story, you can hold up the owner of the store and make him take you to the basement.  

From there you can loot the room, free the man, and find a **Lancaster Repeater**.

locations.title: Shop Robbery: Strawberry General Store
locations.description:
Have a look through the basement window before entering the store. Afterwards, head inside and hold up the owner to make him open the trapdoor to the basement. If you threaten him further, he'll show you a loose brick in the wall.  

Inspect the brick and loot the basement to complete the robbery.

locations.title: Robbery: Saint Denis Gunsmith
locations.description:
There's a security door inside the gunsmith that you should knock on before holding up the owner. Once he opens the door for you, kill the guard on the other side and go to the top floor of the building. You'll find an illegal poker room to loot, as well as a secret safe that the players will show you if you threaten them.  

Bonus points if you can complete the robbery without a single shot fired!

locations.title: Robbery: Valentine Doctor
locations.description: You can knock on the door either at the back of the building or inside the doctor's surgery before holding up the doctor and forcing him to open the back room. Try to escape quickly to avoid a large bounty, but don't forget the money and the **Schofield Revolver**.

locations.title: Coach Robbery: Hector (I, II & III)
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Complete *Friends in Very Low Places* (Chapter 3)  

Hector is a clerk in Strawberry post office who will give you a total of 3 coach robbery missions. Buy the information from him and read the notes in your satchel to find mission details and the coach locations.  

Stolen coaches can be taken to the wagon fence at Emerald Ranch.

locations.title: Coach Robbery: Alden (I, II & III)
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Complete *Friends in Very Low Places* (Chapter 3)  

Alden is a clerk in Rhodes post office who will give you a total of 3 coach robbery missions. Buy the information from him and read the notes in your satchel to find mission details and the coach locations.  

Stolen coaches can be taken to the wagon fence at Emerald Ranch.

locations.title: Rock Carving #2
locations.description: You'll find this carving facing the river.

locations.title: Rock Carving #1
locations.description: This carving is located at the end of the road on Mount Hagen.

locations.title: Rock Carving #4
locations.description:
To find this carving, walk to the edge of the mountain and follow the small mountain pass leading down.
Another way is to jump down from the top of the mountain seen in the screenshot.

locations.title: Rock Carving #3
locations.description: To find this carving, start by approaching the mountains from the southern side of the river. Once you climb to the top, you'll see a passage leading down between the trees. The carving will be near the top, facing the river.

locations.title: Rock Carving #8
locations.description: Just south of Moonstone Pond, you'll find a rock on the plateau with a pyramid carving on it.

locations.title: Rock Carving #9
locations.description: This carving is facing the road.

locations.title: Rock Carving #10
locations.description: This carving can be found east of the Elysian Pool, by the road.

locations.title: Rock Carving #7
locations.description: You'll find this carving near the very top of a cliff.

locations.title: Rock Carving #6
locations.description: This carving can be found by walking to the edge of the mountain and following a path that leads down to a giant skeleton. Walk around the corner to see the carving facing the valley below the mountain.

locations.title: Rock Carving #5
locations.description: You'll see this carving from the western side of Owanjila Lake.

locations.title: Old Harry Fen Shack
locations.description:
This shack is located in the woods south of Braithwaite Manor. Inside, you'll find a picture of a slave's family and a piece of newspaper offering a reward for catching a runaway slave.

After completing Chapter 3 and capturing [Mark Johnson](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=304), finding this newspaper will let you hunt for a new bounty target - [Robbie Laidlaw](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=554).

locations.title: Lenora View
locations.description: This blue shack is located by the road on the eastern slopes of Mount Shann. You'll see a bouquet of flowers by the front door, next to a letter from a man going to [pick up his new wife](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=34785).

locations.title: Clawson's Rest
locations.description: This shack is located just past the Dakota River and the railroad. Inside, you'll find a pulp novel on a small bedside table. There's also [a letter](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892190) inside the drawer.

locations.title: Dodd's Bluff
locations.description: This cabin is located in a valley just south of Window Rock. Inside, you'll come across a murder scene with a gold nugget.

locations.title: Fairvale Shanty
locations.description: _Note: There is usually a grizzly bear or a small pack of wolves in the area._

locations.title: Ridge View Cabin
locations.description: **Note:** Unlocked during the Epilogue.

locations.title: Vetter's Echo Cabin
locations.description: ||Opening the front door will trigger a bear attack. You can ambush the bear yourself by entering through the cabin's broken back door.||

locations.title: Shepherd's Rise Cabin
locations.description: **Note:** Unlocked during the Epilogue.

locations.title: Argil Rise Cabin
locations.description: **Note:** Unlocked during the Epilogue.

locations.title: Taxidermist House
locations.description: Home of the taxidermist. You get invited to visit this cabin after completing all five hunting requests.

locations.title: Adler Ranch
locations.description: **Requirements:** Chapter 2

locations.title: Firwood Rise
locations.description:
Home of Deborah MacGuinness.
You can hear her in the shed.

locations.title: Stilt Shack
locations.description: Inside you can find salted meat, moonshine, and predator bait.

locations.title: The Old Bacchus Place
locations.description: Filled with perfect-quality rats. A [Fertility Statue](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=963) can be found in the chimney.

locations.title: Watson's Cabin
locations.description:
In Watson's Cabin you find an old lady. Enter her house and use the ladder in the back to climb down into the cellar. Steal her [Semi-Automatic Shotgun](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=439453) and leave. 

Return to the cabin the next day, and you'll encounter the lady's four sons. Kill them all and a lockbox will now be available on the kitchen table that was previously not there. The lockbox is the secret stash and contains 1 x $73.  

If you come again a day later, there will be a tombstone for the old lady and a newspaper clipping inside the cabin

**Bonus:** Check the nightstand drawer for a Gold Earring.

locations.title: Witches Cauldron
locations.description: Take a sip to refill your cores.

locations.title: Willard's Rest
locations.description: Home to [The Widow of Willard's Rest](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=6818)

locations.title: Cairn Lodge
locations.description: Visited during [The Noblest of Men, and a Woman](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=42).

locations.title: Chez Porter
locations.description: Climb up a ladder inside the barn to the above floor to find the stash box next to some hay stacks. The treasure box contains two money clips and a jewelry bag.

locations.title: Veteran's Homestead
locations.description: Home to [The Veteran](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=6816).

locations.title: Van Horn Mansion
locations.description:
Go here early in the game to find two residents inside. Enter at night time and you'll find two people sleeping on the lower floor. Steal the money from their table and loot everything else in the house.

(You will not lose honor for killing nor stealing from these folks)

locations.title: Catfish Jacksons
locations.description: This homestead is occupied by a father and son, though you'll sometimes only find the son inside. Look for the shotgun in the living room, and threaten the son to learn where the [stash](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=810) is.

locations.title: Six Point Cabin
locations.description: Home to a [Gang Hideout.](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=401)

locations.title: All That Glitters - Jack Hall Gang Map 1
locations.description:
**Note: May not spawn until starting [All That Glitters](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=36).**

Approach [Caliban's Seat](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=150) from the south and you will be able to ride to the top. Upon reaching the top, before going to the small camp at the very end, head down to the right and follow the path along the narrow cliff-side.

There, you'll find the treasure map in a small gap in the wall along with a pearl necklace - you can sell it or give it to Tilly when she requests one in Chapter 2.

_The next map is found [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=38)._

locations.title: All That Glitters - Jack Hall Gang Map 2
locations.description:
**Note: May not spawn until you've found [All That Glitters - Jack Hall Gang Map 1](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=37).**

Search the pile of rocks with the large rock on top.



_The final treasure is found [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=39)._

locations.title: All That Glitters - Jack Hall Gang Treasure
locations.description:
Approach the island from the peninsula on the western side to avoid drowning. Use the boat near a shack on the eastern shore, or swim to reach the small island in the middle of the lake and inspect the bushes. The treasure is hidden under a rock.  

**Treasure:** Gold Bar x2

**Note:** May not appear until you've found [Map 1](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=37) and [Map 2](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=38).

locations.title: Money Lending and Other Sins
locations.description:
~$35 inside the tree with a hole in it

You need [Chick's Treasure Map](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=928381).

locations.title: Poisonous Trail Treasure Hunt - Map 2
locations.description: Inside the hollow tree at Face Rock

locations.title: Poisonous Trail Treasure Hunt - Map 3
locations.description: On top of the [Serpent Mound](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=906), you'll find **Poisonous Trail Map 3** in the stones that look like a nest of eggs.

locations.title: Poisonous Trail Treasure
locations.description:
**NB: Bring a lantern to see inside the cave, and make sure you've collected the [Poisonous Trail Treasure Hunt - Map 3](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=174), or this treasure won't spawn.**

Walk through the waterfall to find the secret cave. Climb over the first ledge, and drop down the steep drop. Look for another steep path to the right, and head down it.  If you come to a massive chamber with natural light breaking through, you've gone too far.

You'll come to a small triangular tunnel entrance that you have to crouch to go through.  Take the right-hand path after going through.  When this chamber opens up, you'll see a ledge that you need to run and jump off. You'll land below it and slide down into some water, and then you can climb up one last ledge and search for a boulder to find 4 x gold bars ($500).

locations.title: Poisonous Trail Treasure Hunt - Start
locations.description:
Inside the lockbox underneath a bed in the cabin where Flaco Hernandez is encountered during [The Noblest of Men, and a Woman](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=42) - but progressing that questline is not necessary.

The hunt continues [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=173).

locations.title: High Stakes Treasure Map - Map 2
locations.description:
**Requirements:** High Stakes Treasure Map 1, purchased or looted from a treasure hunter found in a random event. If the opportunity is missed three times, the map will be sold by a fence.

The second map is located behind the waterfall here.  You must climb up a log to enter the waterfall. 

_Tip: Use first person view if you can't see anything after entering the waterfall._

**Next Map:** [High Stakes Treasure Map - Map 3](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=307)

locations.title: High Stakes Treasure Map - Map 3
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [High Stakes Treasure Map - Map 2](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=306)

The third map is located inside a hole in a log that bridges from the island to the shore.  To access the log, you must approach from the south side of the island.

locations.title: High Stakes Treasure
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [High Stakes Treasure Map - Map 3](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=307)

When facing the river, take the left path along the cliff edge.  You'll pass a Rock Carving on the way.  Take the path above it.  You'll then need to jump down a gap.  And then fall down once more (you'll take damage this time).  Then crawl under a nearby ledge, and there you'll find 3 x gold bars ($500 each)

locations.title: Otis Miller's Treasure
locations.description:
Hidden inside a small cave.

**Note:** Only available from Epilogue 1 onward.

locations.title: Reed Cottage Treasure - Start
locations.description: Located inside the chimney in Reed Cottage

locations.title: Reed Cottage Treasure
locations.description:
**Requirements:** [Sketched Treasure Map](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=664) from Reed Cottage  
**Reward:** 1 Gold Ingot ($300)

Located under a small rock behind a larger rock in the open.

locations.title: Gold Bar
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Chapter 4 onwards.

**SPOILERS:** The treasure is located a few steps left of the corpse, inside a lockbox that's under a wall to the left of the doorway.

locations.title: Le Tresor Des Morts Treasure - Start
locations.description:
Inside the jail cell on the bed.

**Note:** Only available to those who pre-ordered the digital version of Red Dead Redemption 2 for the PlayStation 4 or Xbox One prior to August 15, 2018.

locations.title: Le Tresor Des Morts Treasure - Map 2
locations.description:
**Prerequisites:** [Le Tresor Des Morts Treasure Map](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=19255)

Within the underground passage, in the dirt wall near a wooden crate with a lamp on it. Look out for a white 'X' carved into the upper top beam.

locations.title: Le Tresor Des Morts Treasure
locations.description:
Inside the small chapel - behind one of the plates.  

**Prerequisites:** [Le Tresor Des Morts Treasure - Map 2](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=19256)  
**Reward:** 6 Gold Bars ($500 each at the Fence).

locations.title: The Elemental Trail Treasure Hunt - Start
locations.description: Shoot the hanging corpse down to loot the _The Elemental Trail Map 1_ from his corpse.

locations.title: The Elemental Trail Treasure Hunt - Map 2
locations.description: The Elemental Trail Map 2 is located inside the fireplace in the ruined house.

locations.title: The Elemental Trail Treasure Hunt - Map 3
locations.description: The Elemental Trail Map 3 is located on the wooden pathway above head. Access via the wooden platform on the hill to the east.

locations.title: The Elemental Trail Treasure
locations.description:
By the grave beside the tree and gate.

**Reward:** 
- Crow Beak Trinket (Looted ammo increased by 10%)
- Large Gold Bar

locations.title: Landmarks of Riches Treasure Hunt - Start
locations.description: Approach the west side of the obelisk where the engraved plaque is located. The map is hidden behind the plaque.

locations.title: Landmarks of Riches Treasure Hunt - Map 2
locations.description: Underneath the bell on the roof of the Tiny Church

locations.title: Landmarks of Riches Treasure Hunt - Map 3
locations.description:
On top of the Mysterious Hill Home - behind the lower boarded up window.

May only appear during the daytime.

locations.title: Landmarks of Riches Treasure Hunt - Map 4
locations.description: Inside the tree on the hill at the center of the Bolger Glade civil war battlefield.

locations.title: Landmarks of Riches Treasure
locations.description:
Under a rock at the base of the sundial on top of Mount Shann

**Treasure:** 6 x Gold Bar

**Note** - You need to have found the [Landmarks of Riches Treasure Hunt - Map 4](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=21252) before it will spawn.

locations.title: Nevada Hat
locations.description:
Behind the waterfall around the same height as the railroad. Approach from the east and drop down to a path, then head towards the waterfall to find it on a rock.

Underneath the hat, you'll find the suicide note of Robert Elliot - a character featured on the Stars of the Stage cigarette cards.

**Note:** There are also some fish (Perch, Chain Pickerel, Bluegill, Rock Bass & Sockeye Salmon) that fall from the waterfall nearby and end up on the cliff edge, making this a very useful spot when attempting Master Hunter Challenge 8.

locations.title: Viking Helmet
locations.description: In a cave near the stone altar, where the Viking Hatchet is found.

locations.title: Pig Mask
locations.description: Hanging beside a pig carcass and some sausages in the shack.

locations.title: Cat Skull Mask
locations.description: Found inside an abandoned building at the water's edge

locations.title: Pagan Skull Mask
locations.description: This mask is on a corpse surrounded by ritualistic markings on the ground.

locations.title: Civil War Hardee Hat
locations.description: Found in the basement of Fort Brennand. The basement entrance is in the hut behind some crates, at the back right.

locations.title: Tricorn Hat
locations.description:
This pirate hat is located behind a wooden wall inside the shipwreck.

To get across the water, you can either hijack a boat as it passes, or cross with your horse at the most shallow point

locations.title: True Tales of Frank Heck, No.102
locations.description: Found on a nightstand inside the shack.

locations.title: Meteorite #2
locations.description: In the hole in the floor inside the [Meteor House](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=152)

locations.title: Torn Treasure Map 2
locations.description:
Found in a drawer inside the hermit's shack. 

This map is one half of a whole. The other half of the map can be found [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=379).

locations.title: Wild West Heroes, No. 132
locations.description: Found on a nightstand in the house at Downes Ranch.

locations.title: Otis Miller and the Arabian Prince
locations.description: Found on a nightstand inside the shack.

locations.title: Torn Treasure Map 1
locations.description:
Found inside a drawer in front of a window in the hermit's shack.

This map is one half of a whole. The other half of the map can be found [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=372).

locations.title: Otis Miller and the Black-Hearted Lady
locations.description: This book is lying on a nightstand inside the Osman Grove shack.

locations.title: Otis Miller and the Boy from New York
locations.description: Found on a table in the abandoned schoolhouse.

locations.title: Abalone Shell Fragment
locations.description:
Found inside an old house just north of the Sheriff's Station.

Used to craft the Bison Horn Talisman.

locations.title: Ram Skull Mask
locations.description:
Found hanging from one of the wooden pillars of the abandoned pergola.

Can be used to conceal your identity while committing crimes.

locations.title: Miner's Hat
locations.description:
On a corpse beside the [Wide-Blade Knife](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=371). Use the plunger by the entrance to blow up the rocks in the way.

This hat is super useful, as it has a built-in light - meaning you don't need to carry your lantern to see in the dark.

locations.title: Morion Helmet
locations.description: Located on the body of the [Frozen Settler](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=896).

locations.title: Cobalt Petrified Wood
locations.description:
Found in a chest on a cart, just under a large overhanging rock. You'll also find some money in the chest.

Used to craft a Boar Tusk Talisman at the Fence.

locations.title: Ancient Viking Comb
locations.description:
On a shelf with 4 skulls on it, beside where the Viking Helmet is. Break open the skulls, and the comb will be underneath.

To ensure you get to keep it, hold off on collecting the comb until the epilogue.

locations.title: Scarecrow Hat
locations.description: On top of the scarecrow in the field (shoot it off the scarecrow to collect it).

locations.title: Female Fertility Statue
locations.description: Found inside a lockbox beneath the chair on the porch of the [Roadside Brothel](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=30355).

locations.title: Fertility Statue
locations.description: Found hidden in the chimney of [The Old Bacchus Place](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=36718).

locations.title: Gold Shield
locations.description:
This item can be taken from Braithwaite Manor, but **only** during the chapter 3 mission *Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern*. 

It is on a mantelpiece downstairs in the first room on the left.

locations.title: Ancient Necklace
locations.description: **Location:** In a drawer inside the Scratching Post shack.

locations.title: Panoramic Map
locations.description: One of many potential spawns for the Panoramic Map, found near a frozen couple as part of a random event.

locations.title: Faded Letter
locations.description:
**Location:** Under a tree in a lock box.
  
**Description:** Letter to Douglas Gray from Lucille Braithwaite

locations.title: Chinese Skullcap
locations.description: **Location:** Beside the corpse of a Chinese man.  On the body you will also find the "Letter to Zhou Yi from Zhou Wei"

locations.title: Ammolite & Fluorite
locations.description:
2 unique gemstones are found inside a birds nest on a high ledge of the mountains.  The path to get there is tricky - approach from the north, just above the train tracks, and hop across the rock ledges.

These can be sold to the fence for $25 each, and you'll also come across a lockbox holding [Aged Pirate Rum, Bill Fold & Coin Bag](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=822) on the way.

locations.title: Ancient Arrowhead
locations.description:
**Required:** Find all 20 [Dreamcatchers](https://rdr2map.com?search=dreamcatcher)

If you connect all Dreamcatcher points on the map, it forms the image of a buffalo. Within Elysian Cave, the item is inside the cave painting of the buffalo.

locations.title: Hawk Talon Trinket
locations.description:
Behind the waterfall at Deadboot Creek, inside a lockbox.

**Requirements:** Chapter 2 onwards  
**Ability:** 30% stamina drain decrease when drawing a bow

locations.title: Cat Eye Trinket
locations.description:
In a lock box by a crate.

**Requirements:** Chapter 2 onwards  
**Ability:** Permanently increases the length of Fortifying tonic effects by 20%

locations.title: Shark Tooth Trinket
locations.description:
In a lock box by the shipwreck.

**Requirements:** Chapter 2 onwards  
**Ability:** Permanently increases player's horse bonding experience by 10%.

locations.title: Turtle Shell Trinket
locations.description:
In a lock box under the stairs. Can only be picked up after killing all Del Lobo enemies nearby.

**Ability:** Permanently increases player's health bar refill speed by 10%.

locations.title: Scarecrow Derby Hat
locations.description: On the scarecrow

locations.title: Scarecrow Sombrero
locations.description: Worn by a scarecrow amongst the corn. You can shoot it off once Dutch lifts the ban on guns in Rhodes, or knock the scarecrow over by riding into it with your horse.

locations.title: Scarecrow Top Hat
locations.description: On the scarecrow. Shoot it off.

locations.title: Meteorite #1
locations.description: Inside the crater

locations.title: Shrunken Head
locations.description: Inside the small cabin.  Shoot the small clay jar below the painting to get the Shrunken Head.

locations.title: Letter to Uncle Lewis from Elijah
locations.description: Found on the body of a runaway slave

locations.title: Electric Lantern
locations.description: After completing [A Bright Bouncing Boy (II)](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=454739), return to his lab after 48 in-game hours have passed.

locations.title: Letter to Garfield from Martha
locations.description: On a dead soldier, pinned to a tree by a bayonet style rifle stuck through him.  He has a "traitor" sign hanging around his neck, and the letter is in his right pocket area.  You may need to use Dead Eye to see the letter.

locations.title: The Lady of the Manor
locations.description:
***Epilogue Only***

Given to you by Mary-Beth when she's encountered at the train station.

locations.title: Letter to Annette from Claude
locations.description:
Inside Robard Farm you will find the the corpses of a man and a woman.

Behind the farm, there is another woman's body lying against the wheel of the wagon, with a Cattleman revolver in her hand.  If you loot her body, you will find this letter revealing the reason they are all dead.

locations.title: Dutch's Speech Notes
locations.description:
On top of a crate located at the very south end of the Horseshoe Overlook camp.

Only found during Chapter 2.

locations.title: Panoramic Map
locations.description: One of many potential spawns for the Panoramic Map, found near a frozen couple as part of a random event.

locations.title: Catherine's Brooch
locations.description:
Can be sold to a fence. You can also find a [Large Gold Bar](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=812) in the house.

**Note:** Only available after the Chapter 3 mission _"Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern"_

locations.title: Old Brass Compass
locations.description:
Rewarded for completing [Geology for Beginners](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=124). 

Required to craft the _Raven Claw Talisman_.

locations.title: Panoramic Map
locations.description: One of many potential spawns for the Panoramic Map, found near a frozen couple as part of a random event.

locations.title: Panama Fedora, Boater Hat, Military Cavalry Hat & Gaucho Hat
locations.description:
All worn by various NPC's at the Rhodes post office.

If stolen, they can be found in your collection when changing clothes.

locations.title: Lost Letter to Bonnie
locations.description: Handed to you by a corpse as part of the Bad Luck, Bonnie random event.

locations.title: Experiment Notes
locations.description: Four experiment notes can be found in the room with the [Manmade Mutant](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=873).

locations.title: English Spelling Practice
locations.description:
Found by the entrance of the burnt church, a letter written by the native students at Fort Riggs.

If you take the first letter of each word, it spells out a secret message:

_Waziya comes with winter breath_    
_His trees stand guard whispering all night that we sleep in our grave_    
_Father fought and died so quickly_     
_Mother dies slow_

locations.title: Letter from Cornwall Kerosene and Tar
locations.description: Found on a corpse at the Oil Derrick

locations.title: Liability Agreement
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [The Wisdom of the Elders](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=6817) V

On a table in Butcher’s Creek

locations.title: Letter to Martha from Garfield
locations.description: On the table in the cabin at Martha's Swain.

locations.title: Grave Newspaper Clipping
locations.description: On a table inside the shack.

locations.title: Letter from St. Luke's Academy
locations.description: You can loot this letter from one of the corpses during the third [Appleseed Timber](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=2414) event, after killing the wolves.

locations.title: Classic Raccoon Mountain Hat
locations.description:
Find a large man named [Jon](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=944) in the Valentine saloon, who will be wearing this iconic hat. After letting him speak, antagonize him and stare him down. He will eventually start a fight with you. You may pick his hat up after the brawl.

_Note: This is a different hat than the one available at the Trapper in the Trophy Buck garment set._

locations.title: Letter to Jim from Mildred
locations.description: Appears on the porch some time after encountering the [Wagon Accident](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=34785)

locations.title: Wild Man's Journal
locations.description: On the animal skeleton at the north end of the Wolfman's Cave.

locations.title: Letter to Micah from Amos
locations.description: During Chapter 4, on top of a crate outside the boathouse you will find a letter from Micah's brother to him.

locations.title: Letter to Glen and Eddie from Momma
locations.description: Found in the nightstand drawer near the beds.

locations.title: Meeting Notes
locations.description: Looted from a KKK Klansman wearing dark robes at any one of their random encounter spots.

locations.title: Native American Ring
locations.description:
Exclusively found on the Drunk Stranger, met at a camp as part of a random encounter.

He'll fall asleep as part of the encounter, letting you loot the ring peacefully.

locations.title: Nite Folk Victim's Note
locations.description: Looted from a body found as part of the first [Nite Folk Victim](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=325) random event.

locations.title: Nite Folk Wagerer's Note
locations.description: Looted from a body found as part of the second [Nite Folk Victim](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=325) random event.

locations.title: Letter to Nigel from Tom
locations.description: Looted from Nigel, loyal friend of Gavin, in any location where he appears.

locations.title: Bride's Photograph
locations.description: Looted from the [Wagon Accident](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=34785)

locations.title: Wedding Certificate
locations.description: Looted from the [Wagon Accident](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=34785)

locations.title: Murfree Brood Prisoner's Note
locations.description: If you find a random Murfree Brood event that features a man hanging from a tree, shoot him down and loot the body to find this note.

locations.title: Gold Earring
locations.description:
Looted from the [Obelisk](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=903)

Used to craft the Boar Tusk Talisman at a fence

locations.title: Quartz Chunk
locations.description:
Given to you via mail for sending a dinosaur bone location to Deborah MacGuinness.

Used to craft the bear claw talisman at any fence.

locations.title: Rock Statue
locations.description: Obtained via mail after sending five rock carving locations to Francis Sinclair.

locations.title: Skull Statue
locations.description: Given to you via mail for sending 15 dinosaur bone locations to Deborah MacGuinness.

locations.title: Algernon's Exotic Hat
locations.description: Reward for completing every stage of [Duchesses and Other Animals](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=651)

locations.title: Letter to Angelo Brontë
locations.description:
This item can be found inside Braithwaite Manor, but only during the chapter 3 mission _Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern._

It is located within the interior of the manor before the main hall burns down.

locations.title: Mine Share
locations.description:
This item can be collected from a table inside Josiah Trelawny's caravan, but only during the chapter 3 mission Magicians for Sport.

It is sitting on top of the small side table inside the trailer.

locations.title: Antique Watch
locations.description:
This item can be looted from Mr. Wrobel's house at Painted Sky, but only after completing the chapter 2 mission Money Lending and Other Sins I.

It is inside a desk drawer, accessible only if the player previously opened the drawer during the debt collection but chose not to take the pocket watch.

locations.title: Charity Handbill
locations.description:
It can be accessed at the stand run by Thomas Downes, but only after the chapter 2 mission "Americans at Rest" and before starting "Money Lending and Other Sins I".

It is located beside the unfinished building in Valentine

locations.title: Oil Company Letter to Cornwall
locations.description: Found in Cornwall's Private Car during the mission "Who The Hell is Leviticus Cornwall"

locations.title: Mining Company Letter to Cornwall
locations.description:
Found during the mission "Who The Hell is Leviticus Cornwall"

_Missable!_

locations.title: Jimmy Brooks Pen
locations.description:
Only obtained from Jimmy Brooks, but only if the player spares his life during the chapter 2 mission Polite Society, Valentine Style.

It is given directly by Jimmy as a reward for your mercy.

locations.title: Jail Cell Key
locations.description: This item can be looted from the Strawberry Sheriff, but only during the chapter 2 mission Blessed are the Meek?.

locations.title: Electric Chair Blueprint
locations.description:
This item can be collected from the corpse of the professor after the final mission in _The Mercies of Knowledge_ strand, which becomes available in chapter 4.

It is missable if not collected immediately after the death of the professor.

locations.title: List of Accounts
locations.description: It can be found in Angelo Bronte's mansion on a desk, during the mission "Revenge is a Dish Best Eaten".

locations.title: Telegram to Police Chief Lambert
locations.description: It can be found on a table during the mission "Revenge is a Dish Best Eaten" in Chapter 4.

locations.title: Letter to Brontë From the Mayor
locations.description: This item can be collected on the desk upstairs after following the butler in the mission _The Gilded Cage_.

locations.title: Letter to Tom From Colm
locations.description:
Can be collected if you loot the O'Driscoll that Sadie Kills at the end of the mission "Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow"

Missable if not collected immediately after the cutscene ends.

locations.title: Owl Feather Trinket
locations.description:
Given by Rains Fall during the mission "Archaeology for Beginners" if the soldiers in the camp are not killed or harmed while retrieving the chanupa. 

_Tip: You can still be seen by the soldiers, just do not kill or harm them. Run around the camp hogtying the soldiers for an easier time._

locations.title: Emerald
locations.description:
Obtained when completing all of the [He's British, of Course](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=121) missions.

Fetches $50 when sold.

locations.title: Penelope's Bracelet
locations.description:
Given to Arthur by Penelope Braithwaite after completing the mission "The Course of True Love V". 

You can turn down the reward, but this is the **only chance** to receive this unique item.

locations.title: Civil War Handcuffs
locations.description:
Given to you via mail when you mail one full set of cigarette cards to Phineas T. Ramsbottom.

Used to craft the Alligator Tooth Trinket.

locations.title: Family Photograph
locations.description: Found under the floorboards in the [Old Harry Fen Shack](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=194)

locations.title: Get Rich Quick
locations.description: Can be bought for $50 or stolen from Timothy Donahue in a back alley in Saint Denis.

locations.title: Hopes For The Future
locations.description: Given by [Dr. Macintosh](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=942) by interacting with him in Annesburg.

locations.title: Erotic Photograph x5
locations.description: Inside the cave where you find [Otis Miller's Revolver](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=311).

locations.title: A Day's Walk Poem
locations.description:
Located in a drawer in Vetter's Echo Cabin.

||_There's a bear inside the cabin - if you enter from the rear you'll get to attack it first._||

locations.title: Dear Annabella Poem
locations.description:
Found in a drawer in Vetter's Echo Cabin with A Day's Walk Poem.

||_There's a bear inside the cabin - if you enter from the rear you'll get to attack it first._||

locations.title: Eugenics Handbill
locations.description:
Given by the [Eugenics Proponent](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=952).

Be sure to repay him with a knuckle sandwich.

locations.title: Chelonian Handbill
locations.description:
Given by [Anders Helgerson](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=951).

All hail the turtle!

locations.title: Gideon Bennett Bounty Poster
locations.description: Found on the side of the Annesburg post office. This poster does not trigger a bounty mission, and is purely collectable.

locations.title: Civil War Report
locations.description: Found in the basement of Fort Brennand. The basement entrance is in the hut behind some crates, at the back right.

locations.title: Chick's Treasure Map
locations.description: Can be collected from Chick Matthews during his debt collection mission if you loot him instead of letting him go.

locations.title: Letter to Nate from Momma
locations.description: On the nightstand in one of the bedrooms.

locations.title: Letter to Momma
locations.description: A corpse being thrown into a pit here can be looted for this unfinished letter.

locations.title: Letter to Brother Rodolfo
locations.description: Looted from a long-dead [Jesuit Missionary](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=900).

locations.title: Gold Wedding Ring
locations.description:
Near the railroad, north of Heartland Overflow, worn by a black sheep.

Killing the sheep will decrease your Honor.

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Enter the small wooden Sheriff's building in Limpany and walk behind the desk. 
- Gold Bar
- Special Horse Stimulant Pamphlet

locations.title: Jewelry
locations.description: Found inside a lockbox in the burned-out ruins of the Adler Ranch.

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Found in a hollow tree stump on the south side of the Barrow Lagoon.
- Miracle Tonic
- Money

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Found inside a chest at the foot of a small wooden bridge.  
- Dynamite Arrow Pamphlet
- Guarma Rum
- Large Jewelry Bag

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Hidden inside a lockbox to the right of the door [Mysterious Hill Home](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=90). By the broken wagon
- Poison Arrow Pamphlet
- Chewing Tobacco

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Inside the witch's hut.
- Hair Tonic
- Kentucky Bourbon

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
On top of some crates in the Fairwale Shanty Shack.  

- Gold Nugget
- Platinum Band
- Jewelry

locations.title: Aged Pirate Rum
locations.description: Found on top of a rocky ledge, hidden behind the Brandywine Drop - around halfway up the waterfall. Look out for a dead tree on the eastern side to find the path to the ledge.

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Found inside the derailed yellow train carriage (laying on its side) that has fallen off the bridge.
- Large Jewelry Bag
- Money

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Found in the small mausoleum east of Shady Belle.
- Large Jewelry Bag
- Money

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Found in a lockbox at the foot of a small hut southeast of Shady Belle.
- Aged Pirate Rum
- Money

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
There are three separate lockboxes found underneath a ruined wall in the abandoned church.
- Large Jewelry Bag 
- Platinum Earrings
- Bill Fold
- Gold Pocket Watch

There is also Aged Pirate Rum on the wall of the church's upper landing.

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Found between two wagon wheels, directly east from Bolger Glade.
- Guarma Rum
- Express Rifle Cartridges

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Found in the space underneath Catfish Jackson's House, on the northwestern side.
- Aged Pirate Rum
- Chewing Tobacco
- Money

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Found on the southernmost island, at the foot of a dead tree hung with drying fish.
- Large Jewelry Bag
- Potent Miracle Tonic
- Revolver Ammo

locations.title: Aged Pirate Rum
locations.description: Found inside the shipwreck.

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Found inside the shack at Lone Mule Stead.
- Large Jewelry Bag
- Express Rifle Cartridges

locations.title: Money
locations.description: Found at the bottom of the old well, just south-west of the northernmost hut.

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Inside a lockbox found between the crates that are scattered near an abandoned wagon south of Owanjila Dam.
- Chewing Tobacco
- Money
- Special Bitters Pamphlet

locations.title: Gold Nugget x3
locations.description: Found inside a lock box by the wagon on the riverbank.

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Found at a blood-spattered tent on the rocky plateau, near the ridge.
- Predator Bait
- Rifle Cartridges
- Special Miracle Tonic Pamphlet
- Silver Watch
- Coin Pouch

locations.title: Money
locations.description:
Found on the upper floor of the Hanging Dog Ranch, beside the two bunk beds.

There is also a jewellery bag and coin purse on the ground floor inside the cabinet near the fireplace.

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
- **Valerian Root** - On top of a tree stump acting as a table on the ground floor.
- **Aged Pirate Rum & Coin Bag** - Found on the upper floor of the cabin.

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Found on the edge of the cliff - at the foot of a small dead tree next to two skeletons.
- Large Jewelry Bag
- Money
- Small Jewelry Bag x2

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Found on a narrow ledge just below the summit.
- Aged Pirate Rum
- Bill Fold
- Coin Bag

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Found in a lockbox on the scaffolding for the [Face in Cliff](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=866). Approach from the north.
- Apple
- Guarma Rum
- Jewelry
- Special Health Cure Pamphlet
- Note from the Sculptor

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Found at Hani's Bethel, in a chest underneath a broken wagon.
- Guarma Rum
- Money
- Volatile Dynamite Pamphlet

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
Found inside the Beaver Hollow cave, in the westernmost chamber.
- Jewelry
- Money
- Valerian Root

locations.title: Large Jewelry Bag
locations.description:
Found in the cave behind the Elysian Pool Waterfall.

To get here, as you enter the cave crawl down to the bottom of the crevasse on your right.  If you crouch you will find a tunnel dug into the side of the crevasse.  Crawl into the tunnel and take the first turn to your right.  In there will be a loot box with the large jewelry bag

locations.title: Money
locations.description: Found underneath the southern end of the log bridge.

locations.title: Loot

He'll only appear the first time you visit the shack, so don't forget to pick it up (though it is possible that he'll rise from the dead and give you another chance to loot it after 3-4 in-game days!)

locations.title: Midnight's Pistol
locations.description:
**Requirements:** The Noblest of Man, and a Woman stranger mission.

To obtain this pistol, you must kill Billy Midnight.

Speak to the train station clerk and he will reveal that Billy Midnight should be on one of the next two trains. Wait outside and board the first train that arrives.  Midnight will be in the last wagon. You must chase and duel him.

locations.title: Schofield Revolver
locations.description:
To obtain the revolver, first you must go to the back of the Doctor's Office and peer through the window.  This will unlock a hidden operation.

Then hold up the store, and kill the men in the back room.  The revolver will be in a box on the table.

locations.title: Flaco's Revolver

After making progress in [The Noblest of Men, and a Woman](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=42), you'll come here to chat with Flaco Hernandez. It won't end well, but once he's dead, you can pick up his revolver.

*Note - if you don't pick it up, it may disappear by the time you return.*

locations.title: Bad Luck, Bonnie
locations.description:
One of a few potential spawn locations for a 'corpse' that holds the [Lost Letter to Bonnie](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=454465). He'll hand it to you when you try to loot him.

Two chests can be found nearby, too - their loot includes a Silver Pocket Watch & Gin, Guarma Rum, Shotgun Shells, Money & Chewing Tobacco.

locations.title: High Stakes Treasure Hunter
locations.description:
Holds the first High Stakes Treasure Map. You'll need to rob, kill and loot, or purchase it from him for $5.

If you fail to recover the map from him on 3 separate occasions, it will become available for purchase at a Fence.

The treasure hunt continues [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=306).

locations.title: Nite Folk Victim
locations.description:
Come here at night, and find a man hung from a tree at the side of the road. After approaching the body, you'll be attacked by three enemies from a faction known as the **Nite Folk.**

After killing them, shoot down the body and loot it to find the [Nite Folk Victim's Note](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892454)

The second time you encounter this event, you will find the [Nite Folk Wagerer's Note](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892455)

locations.title: Ku Klux Klan Meeting
locations.description:
One of many potential locations for a KKK meeting.

They tend to be hostile if you approach. Killing and looting a Klansman wearing dark robes gives you the unique [Meeting Notes](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892449) letter.

locations.title: Crying Woman
locations.description:
Wandering the swamps, you might hear a crying woman. If you approach her, she'll attack and run away. Shoot her from afar for a closer look at her mottled gray skin and white eyes, or chase her to be attacked by a group of Nite Folk.

Rest assured, it gets creepier. If you camp near the area and sleep until midnight, then activate focus, you'll find the tracks of a "Stranger" leading away from where you were sleeping... right to the "crying" woman.

locations.title: Arm Amputation
locations.description:
A man on a horse will call for help, and then fall over. He'll ask you to take him to a doctor in Saint Denis, where you can stick around to watch his arm be sawed off.

A few days later, you can find the man being hanged for killing a woman that made fun of his disfigurement. You can help him again, or leave him to his fate.

locations.title: Ghost of Agnes Dowd
locations.description:
Available during foggy weather between 9pm - 3am

Agnes will appear as a white ghost, or be totally invisible, and can be heard crying. Use your binoculars for a closer look, as she will fade away if you get too close.  

You can encounter this event 16 times, with 2 in-game days between each encounter.  Each time she will have unique dialog.  After the 16th time she won't spawn again.

locations.title: Cave Hermit
locations.description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward  

There are 5 possible stages, each available at least 3 in-game days after the previous one. You'll need to stay in his presence long enough to hear all the man has to say (and to actually see him), even if he asks you to go away.

locations.title: Blind Man Cassidy
locations.description:
Available from Epilogue 1 onward. 

Give this mystical blind man a dollar, and he'll share cryptic visions of the future.

He appears in multiple locations, sharing 18 different visions in total (with roughly 3 in-game days needing to pass between each encounter.) 

A further 8 visions are available in the Epilogue.

The final interaction is only available from Epilogue 1 onward.

locations.title: Chelonian Master
locations.description:
**Epilogue Only**

The leader of the turtle-worshipping cult can be seen jumping off a cliff with his followers. Foreshadowed by an interaction with [Anders Helgerson](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=951)

locations.title: Dr. Macintosh
locations.description:
Chapter 2 onward  

Accept the doctor's book, [Hopes For The Future](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=927002), and return at least 3 in-game days later to unlock a second interaction.

locations.title: Thomas Downes
locations.description:
Available from the beginning of Chapter 2 until *Sodom? Back to Gomorrah* (Chapter 3)  

There are 2 different conversations to experience: one before completing *Americans at Rest* (Chapter 2), and one after.

locations.title: Jon
locations.description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward - between 12PM & 6AM  

Jon is often seen ranting in Valentine's Smithfields saloon. If you stay close, he will eventually attack you. Knock him out to pick up his [Classic Raccoon Mountain Hat](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892166).

You can also return at a later date to find him in the saloon - without his hat. If you wear his hat in front of him, he'll attack you again.

locations.title: Constipated Man
locations.description:
Available from Chapter 2, during / after *Polite Society, Valentine Style*  

A constipated man can be heard struggling inside room 2A at the hotel in Valentine.

locations.title: Nicholas Timmins
locations.description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward - between 8AM & 8PM  

The mayor of Strawberry welcomes folks to his town.

3 interactions can be triggered (the first 2 at the Welcome Center, the 3rd in the main street), with at least 2 in-game days between them.

locations.title: Reverend
locations.description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward - between 8AM & 7PM  

After your initial encounter, you can meet him again if you come back at least 24 in-game hours later.

There are three stages of interaction. The final interaction is only available from Epilogue 1 onward.

locations.title: Homeless Vet Mickey
locations.description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward  

Asks for money in a few spots throughout Valentine. 

There are 6 stages of interaction, with a minimum of 3 in-game days between each one. A 7th stage is unlocked from Epilogue 1 onward.

locations.title: Homeless Vet Mickey
locations.description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward  

Asks for money in a few spots throughout Valentine. 

There are 6 stages of interaction, with a minimum of 3 in-game days between each one. A 7th stage is unlocked from Epilogue 1 onward.

locations.title: Dorothea
locations.description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward - between 8AM & 6PM  

A suffragette campaigning for women's right to vote. After your first encounter, you can experience a second one by coming back at least 1 in-game day later.

locations.title: Anders Helgerson
locations.description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward - between 8AM & 6PM  

Anders is a recruiter for the Chelonian Cult, and will offer you a pamphlet if you talk to him.

A second interaction awaits in the epilogue, and leads to the [Chelonian Master](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=941) encounter.

locations.title: Eugenics Proponent
locations.description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward - between 8AM & 6PM  

If you accept a pamphlet from this man, a cutscene ensues. He will run away from you at the next encounter (which is available 1 in-game day after the first), and can be killed with no consequences.

locations.title: Timothy Donahue
locations.description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward  

The author of *Get Rich Quick* sells his work for $50. 

If you come back at least 2 in-game days later, you can demand a refund - though you will have to chase him down and loot him for it.

locations.title: Lillian Powell
locations.description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward - between 9AM & 9PM  

A drunk, aging writer in the Saint Denis saloon. There are 4 stages to experience, each one 3 in-game days after the last.

locations.title: Sonny
locations.description:
Available in Chapter 2 onward  

Sonny lives in a cabin here. If you accept his invitation to come inside, you will wake up in the wilderness with some of your money missing and your cores exhausted.

locations.title: Joe Butler
locations.description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward  

Joe begs outside the Rhodes General Store. There are initially 3 stages of interaction, with 3 in-game days between them. A 4th one is unlocked from Epilogue 1 onward.

locations.title: Soothsayer
locations.description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward  

An old, near-blind woman wanders the swamps, telling fortunes in exchange for money.

There are 15 interaction stages, with 3 in-game days between them.

The first 10 interactions can be triggered between Chapters 2 - 6, and the last 5 once you begin Epilogue 1.

locations.title: Execution, Tumbleweed Style
locations.description:
Available from Epilogue 1 onward.

A deputy turns in a Del Lobo in Tumbleweed, and the Sheriff executes the outlaw.  

Witnessing this encounter unlocks two bounty hunter missions.

locations.title: Castor's Ridge Homestead
locations.description:
Available until the end of Chapter 6

A man and his sons building a house. Return here frequently to receive small side quests from them. There are 4 stages in total.

locations.title: Appleseed Timber
locations.description:
A small lumber camp in the forest has three random events to offer, but they **can only be started before the end of Chapter 6.**

The [Letter from St. Luke's Academy](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892150) can be looted from the third event.

locations.title: Central Union Railroad
locations.description:
Available until the end of Chapter 6

There are 3 stages to experience.  Note that the camp will move slightly north-west as the stages progress

locations.title: Valentine Hotel Robbery - Room 1B
locations.description:
A stranger here will tell you that his friend double-crossed him, and he wants to get him back.  You'll need to rob the friend's room (1B, bottom floor, opposite the baths) in the nearby Valentine Hotel.  You'll find $50 there, and you'll have the option to split the money with the stranger, or break your word and keep all $50.

**NB:** Some users have mentioned that they cannot find any loot inside the hotel room.  It's unknown if this is a bug or not.

A lost New Yorker asks for help finding the way to Strawberry.

locations.title: Feral Man
locations.description:
Follow the howls to encounter a naked wolf man and find his cave. 

Killing the wolves will result in honor loss.

locations.title: Mexican Gunslinger Challenge
locations.description: A Mexican gunslinger will challenge you to a competition to shoot the most bottles and birds.

locations.title: Tree House Man
locations.description: **Interaction:** Upon approaching this tree house, a stranger will start yelling at you. Shoot the floorboards to bring him crashing down to earth.

locations.title: William
locations.description:
William the Herbalist has a chance to appear here after completing [To the Ends of the Earth](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=21182)

Give him the herbs he asks for to receive another bottle of Special Miracle Tonic.

locations.title: Mexican Gunslinger Challenge
locations.description: A Mexican gunslinger will challenge you to a competition to shoot the most bottles and birds.

locations.title: Damnable Beast
locations.description:
A stranger is trying to heal the foot of his mount. 

Your arrival will startle him, usually triggering a fatal kick to the head from his horse - though this isn't always guaranteed.

**Tip:** If the stranger's horse bolts, you can chase it down and catch it.

locations.title: O'Driscoll Debt Collection
locations.description:
Two O'Driscolls beating a man near a tree. They demand the man pays them what he owes - what happens next is up to you.

_If you intervene,_ you'll receive Honor after fighting the two O'Driscolls. 

_If you do not intervene,_ the man is knocked out and you will lose Honor.

locations.title: O'Driscolls
locations.description: O'Driscolls may attack you or otherwise have a presence in this area.

locations.title: Wolf Attack
locations.description:
A man being mauled by a wolf. 

Kill the wolf, and you'll get the option to share a whiskey or health cure with the man to gain some honor. 

Unfortunately, he'll die from blood loss either way.

locations.title: Kidnapping
locations.description:
A woman can be heard shouting - she's been tied up and thrown onto the back of a horse! 

Kill or hogtie the would-be kidnapper to receive honor.

locations.title: Grand Theft Horse
locations.description:
A Mexican stranger will ask for help after losing his horse. 

If you stop to help, he may attempt to steal *your* horse - and if you hesitate to answer him he might rob you at gunpoint!

locations.title: Prisoner Encounter
locations.description:
A prisoner chained to the rocks may ask you to shoot his chains off.  If you free him, he'll give you the location of this buried [Gold Bar](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=25168)

It's also possible to hogtie and turn him over to any sheriff for a cash reward.

locations.title: Blind Man Cassidy
locations.description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward. 

Give this mystical blind man a dollar, and he'll share cryptic visions of the future.

He appears in multiple locations, sharing 18 different visions in total (with roughly 3 in-game days needing to pass between each encounter.) 

A further 8 visions are available in the Epilogue.

locations.title: Back Alley Mugging
locations.description:
At night, visiting the end of this T-shaped junction at the corner of the church will see a stranger offering to sell weapons.

Follow him, and money will certainly change hands. Return here afterwards to get it back.

locations.title: William

Give him the herbs he asks for to receive another bottle of Special Miracle Tonic.

locations.title: Duel With a Drunk
locations.description: When walking into the bar, a drunkard may bump into you and then challenge you to a duel.

locations.title: Big Hank Likes a Spank
locations.description:
At night, if you peer through the window of the house, you'll find a woman spanking a bare-assed man.

You can watch it until you get caught and you lose honor.

locations.title: O'Driscolls
locations.description: O'Driscolls may attack you or otherwise have a presence in this area.

locations.title: The Accident
locations.description:
At night, a prostitute may ask for your help disposing of a body. She killed a man up in her room in the saloon and needs help dealing with it. She will reward you with money, and if you come back in a few days, she'll approach you again with a similar problem. If you help her again you'll lose Honor.


**Tip:** Return to Valentine in the Epilogue and speak to the bartender in the [Saloon](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=168). He'll tell you that the prostitute was actually a serial killer and has been caught; pay a visit to the sheriff's office to find her in one of the jail cells. After this, you can witness her execution by hanging near the [Butcher](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=166).

locations.title: Wagon Accident
locations.description:
A stranger may call you over to the cliff, where a wagon has crashed on the rocks below.

Search the body down below to find the [Bride's Photograph](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892803), and a lockbox on the wagon to find the [Wedding Certificate](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892804)

locations.title: Cougar Attack
locations.description:
A man is hiding in a tree from a very angry cougar. 

Kill the cougar to save him and gain Honor.

locations.title: Woeful Lover
locations.description:
A young man whines about the apple of his eye, Lily May.

He can be encountered a few times, with a final meeting available in the Epilogue that can play out differently based on your earlier choice to greet or antagonise.

locations.title: Panning for Gold
locations.description:
A man panning for gold by the river. 

He'll say that he hasn't found anything, and asks you to move along. If you remain in the area there is a chance the man will find a gold nugget... which you can steal.

locations.title: Couple Smoking Opium
locations.description:
At night, you can see two men peeking through the window. Join them, and you'll see a man and woman rolling around on the bed and floor while smoking a pipe. 

You can chase the men away to gain honor, but you will lose honor for peeking yourself, and continue to lose more honor if you stay and watch.

locations.title: Horse Race
locations.description:
Get ready for a friendly horse race! 

Three races can be found as random events.

You can chase the men away to gain honor, but will lose it for peeking yourself - and may even get a wanted level if you stay and watch.

locations.title: Safe-Breakers

You can open it yourself with dynamite, or wait for the men to get it open before swooping in to claim the loot for yourself.

locations.title: Moonshiners
locations.description:

Rewards can include aged pirate rum, cash, and honor - but with some herbs being poisonous, their luck is sure to run out eventually.

locations.description:
A stranger may approach, asking for help with a snakebite. Hand over a health cure or personally suck out the venom to save him and gain honor.

A few in-game days later, you may find the stranger in a nearby settlement, where he'll cover the cost of your next purchase from a local shop.

locations.title: Nite Folk Victim
locations.description:
Come here at night, and find a man hung from a tree at the side of the road. After approaching the body, you'll be attacked by three enemies from a faction known as the **Nite Folk.**

After killing them, shoot down the body and loot it to find the [Nite Folk Victim's Note](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892454)

The second time you encounter this event, you will find the [Nite Folk Wagerer's Note](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892455)

locations.title: Drunk Stranger

Unfortunately, he'll die from blood loss either way.

locations.title: Blind Beggar
locations.description:
There's a blind beggar asking for money. Giving him 50 cents will reward you with some Honor.

Eventually, the beggar will get up and walk away with a hearty laugh - he was only pretending to be blind. You can point your gun at him to force a confession.

locations.title: Police Chase
locations.description:
While walking through this street you can come across a police officer chasing a thief. 

Follow them to watch the thief get knocked out and carried away.

locations.title: Mutilated Horse & Nite Folk Ambush
locations.description:
A cart holding a mutilated horse can be found here. Proceeding past it into the swamp (or chasing your horse if it's spooked by the sight) will lead to an ambush from a small group of Nite Folk.

**Tip:** Don't let your horse go too far - the Nite Folk may kill it.

locations.title: Bad Luck, Bonnie
locations.description:
One of a few potential spawn locations for a 'corpse' that holds the [Lost Letter to Bonnie](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=454465). He'll hand it to you when you try to loot him.

Two chests can be found nearby, too - their loot includes a Silver Pocket Watch & Gin, Guarma Rum, Shotgun Shells, Money & Chewing Tobacco.

locations.title: Nite Folk: Crying Woman
locations.description:
Try wandering the area at night, and you might hear a crying woman.  If you approach her, she'll attack and run away. Shoot her from afar for a closer look at her mottled gray skin and white eyes, or chase her to be attacked by a group of Nite Folk.

Rest assured, it gets creepier. If you camp near the area and sleep until midnight, then activate focus, you'll find the tracks of a "Stranger" leading away from where you were sleeping... right to the "crying" woman.

_Tip: Use a varmint rifle or small game arrows for clean kills - they will count as Perfect Rat Carcasses for Hunting Request #2._

She will reward you with 50$, found in a sack of grain to the left of the front door's interior, and you'll receive honor.

locations.title: Hunter's Camp
locations.description:
A man at a campfire will warn you to stay away from the [Aberdeen Pig Farm](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=109) when you interact with him.

The man can be encountered multiple times before you visit the Aberdeen Pig Farm, though he will keep repeating the same dialogue. At his camp, you can cut the carcasses down that hang behind him. The carcasses that spawn will be a random mix of ducks, rabbits and/or foxes. When you skin them, they will always have perfect pelts.
