locations.title: Back Alley Mugging
locations.description:
At night, visiting the end of this T-shaped junction at the corner of the church will see a stranger offer you the chance to make a whole lot of money. 

Follow him, and hard-earned money will certainly change hands. Return here afterwards to get it back.

locations.title: Lemoyne Arsonists
locations.description:
Between 12AM & 6AM, three Lemoyne Raiders throw fire bottles at City Hall and flee. 

They will attack if you antagonize them, but lawmen will not react if you kill them.

locations.title: Wagon Watching
locations.description:
A concussed / drunk man will ask you to watch his wagon. You can agree to receive honor, but he won't come back no matter how long you wait.

You'll find [Valerian Root](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892451) nearby.

locations.title: Criminal Masterminds

If you do, and disarm your opponent, you'll receive honor. There are no consequences for killing him, however.

locations.title: Missing Dog

If you agree to help, you can use focus to find its trail, and can greet the dog to guide it back to its owner. You'll receive honor for the good deed.

locations.title: Mugging
locations.description:
A couple held up at gunpoint. If you choose to intervene, killing the mugger, you will be thanked by the couple and receive honor.

Act quickly, or the mugging will turn into a double homicide.

locations.title: Missing Dog

If you agree to help, you'll find it under the saloon, and can greet the dog to guide it back to its owner. You'll receive honor for the good deed.

locations.title: O'Driscoll Debt Collection

If you intervene, you'll receive Honor after fighting the two O'Driscolls.

If you do not intervene, the man is knocked out and you will lose Honor.

locations.title: Prisoner Wagon
locations.description:
Lawmen are transporting a criminal inside a prison wagon. 

Killing the lawmen yourself will decrease honor, but shooting the lock will let the prisoner out, increasing honor.

If the prisoner survives the skirmish, they'll give you a Home Robbery tip.

locations.title: Moonshiners
locations.description:
A pair of moonshiners that can be encountered multiple times. At first, they will try to chase you away, but will eventually ask for help that you can provide by fetching herbs.

Rewards can include aged pirate rum, cash, and honor - but with some herbs being poisonous, their luck is sure to run out eventually.

locations.title: Damnable Beast
locations.description:
A stranger is trying to heal the foot of his mount. 

Your arrival will startle him, usually triggering a fatal kick to the head from his horse - though this isn't always guaranteed.

**Tip:** If the stranger's horse bolts, you can chase it down and catch it.

locations.title: Coyote Hunter
locations.description:
A hunter is tracking a coyote.

He'll eventually manage to track and kill it, and despite claiming it's for his dinner, he'll only take the pelt - leaving you with a perfect carcass for *your* dinner.

locations.title: Wagon Scavenger
locations.description: A man can be found looting two corpses; one on a wagon, the other laying near it.

locations.title: Wagon Scavenger
locations.description: A man can be found looting two corpses; one on a wagon, the other laying near it.

locations.title: Herb Enthusiast
locations.description:
A herb collector (not William) will tell you about the plant he's gathering. After picking a few, he'll leave the rest for you. 

The man can be encountered in New Hanover, Big Valley, and Scarlett Meadows, collecting a different herb in each encounter.

locations.title: High Stakes Treasure Hunter
locations.description:
Holds the first High Stakes Treasure Map. You'll need to rob, kill and loot, or purchase it from him for $5.

If you fail to recover the map from him on 3 separate occasions, it will become available for purchase at a Fence.

The treasure hunt continues [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=306).

locations.title: Coyote Hunter
locations.description:
A hunter is tracking a coyote.

He'll eventually manage to track and kill it, and despite claiming it's for his dinner, he'll only take the pelt - leaving you with a perfect carcass for *your* dinner.

locations.title: Dead Weight
locations.description: A woman's horse has collapsed on top of her. Rescue and deliver her to a nearby settlement to receive honor.

locations.title: Classic Bill
locations.description:
Javier may approach you with news that Bill has been cornered by bounty hunters.

He'll be okay if you refuse to help, but choosing to intervene will see you fight alongside Javier and receive some honor.

locations.title: Prisoner Encounter
locations.description:
A prisoner may ask you to shoot his chains off. If you free him, he'll give you a Home Robbery tip.

It's also possible to hogtie and turn him over to any sheriff for a cash reward.

locations.title: Safe-Breakers
locations.description:
Two men trying to open a safe by any means necessary.

You can open it yourself with dynamite, or wait for the men to get it open before swooping in to claim the loot for yourself.

locations.title: Safe-Breakers
locations.description:
Two men trying to open a safe by any means necessary.

You can open it yourself with dynamite, or wait for the men to get it open before swooping in to claim the loot for yourself.

locations.title: Bounty Hunters
locations.description:
Two bounty hunters are transporting a wanted criminal. 

The fugitive will cry for help; killing the bounty hunters will give you the option to free the criminal or complete the delivery to claim their bounty for yourself. 

Freeing the fugitive will provide you with a Store Robbery tip.

locations.title: Snake Bite Victim
locations.description:
A stranger may approach, asking for help with a snakebite. Hand over a health cure or personally suck out the venom to save him and gain honor.

A few in-game days later, you may find the stranger in a nearby settlement, where he'll cover the cost of your next purchase from a local shop.

locations.title: Murfree Brood
locations.description: The Murfree Brood may attack you or otherwise have a presence in this area.

locations.title: Camper
locations.description:
A friendly stranger may have a camp here. 

If you sit with them, they'll tell you a story about their time working at Emerald Ranch, and the rumours surrounding Miriam Wegner.

locations.title: Camper
locations.description:
A friendly stranger may have a camp here.

If you sit with him, he'll discuss his visit to Manzanita Post and how the people there acted quite strangely, a hint alluding to the mystery going on in that location.

locations.title: My Leg!
locations.description:
Two men may exit the post office, with one showing off a new revolver. The wielder will wave it around and jokingly aim at his friend, who will tell him to stop. He will ignore his friend and accidentally shoot himself in the leg.

The two will then depart, and the man will limp around town for some time before sitting on the porch of the doctor's office with a cigarette.

locations.title: Grizzly Hunter
locations.description: Join the hunter and rescue him from a bear to receive honor.

locations.title: Camper
locations.description:
A friendly stranger may have a camp here.

If you sit with them, they'll talk about a drunken night they spent in Tumbleweed and a run in with the Sheriff there.

locations.title: Camper
locations.description:
A friendly stranger may have a camp here.

If you sit with them, they'll discuss the plague in Armadillo and how a figure bearing a striking resemblance to the Strange Man has been seen around there.

locations.title: Camper
locations.description:
A friendly stranger may have a camp here.

If you sit with them, they'll tell you a story about the legendary bounty hunter Red Harlow - protagonist of the first game in the Red Dead series, Red Dead Revolver.

locations.title: Del Lobo Troublemakers
locations.description: A group of three Del Lobos will ride into town and start shooting up the place; if you intervene and then antagonize them, you will gain Honor.

locations.title: Fleeing Family
locations.description: A woman will be sitting on a wagon as her husband hastily packs up their belongings; if questioned, they will express their desire to leave Armadillo in the wake of the Cholera epidemic, after which they will depart.

locations.title: Undertaker
locations.description: Here you can find an undertaker loading a body into a wagon before proceeding to take them to the other side of town to be buried. You can question him for more information.

locations.title: Sick Undertaker
locations.description: You can find a sickly undertaker here taking a body off a cart, only to become so exhausted he needs to rest. You can ask if he's alright, but it's not looking good.

locations.title: Del Lobo Breakout
locations.description: Upon arriving in Armadillo, three Del Lobos will be demanding the Sheriff release their fellow gang member; if you intervene and kill the Del Lobos, you will gain Honor and the Sheriff will express his thanks before promptly retiring - but not before letting you know you can take the loot in his desk as thanks.

locations.title: Classic Uncle
locations.description: Uncle still can't catch a break, and may be thrown out of Blackwater's saloon.

locations.title: Lemoyne Raiders
locations.description: Lemoyne Raiders may attack you or otherwise have a presence in this area.

locations.title: Kidnapping
locations.description:
A woman can be heard shouting - she's been tied up and thrown onto the back of a horse!

Kill or hogtie the would-be kidnapper to receive honor.

locations.title: Lemoyne Raiders

locations.title: Damsel in Distress?
locations.description: A woman by the road asks for help. As soon as you approach her, she will stand up and take aim at you, with two accomplices waiting nearby.

locations.title: Poisoned Stranger
locations.description: A man is vomiting after eating something poisonous and asks for medicine. You gain honor if you save him. You can find the herb he ate nearby.

locations.title: Damsel in Distress?
locations.description: A woman by the road asks for help. As soon as you approach her, she will stand up and take aim at you, with two accomplices waiting nearby.

locations.title: Grand Theft Horse
locations.description:
A Mexican stranger will ask for help after losing his horse. 

If you stop to help, he may attempt to steal *your* horse - and if you hesitate to answer him he might rob you at gunpoint!

locations.title: Wolf Attack
locations.description:
A man being mauled by a wolf. 

Kill the wolf, and you'll get the option to share a whiskey or health cure with the man to gain some honor. 

Unfortunately, he'll die from blood loss either way.

locations.title: Herb Enthusiast

locations.title: Outlaw Attack
locations.description: An outlaw can be heard shouting to members of his gang, stating that first to kill the player will be rewarded with gold. Four outlaws on horses will attack the player. This event can only occur in Chapter 2.

locations.title: Murfree Brood

locations.title: Panning for Gold
locations.description:
A man panning for gold by the river.

He'll say that he hasn't found anything, and asks you to move along. If you remain in the area there is a chance the man will find a gold nugget... which you can steal.

locations.description:
You can donate $20 to support the Homeless Veteran Shelter (or you can loot the lock box). 

**Quest Giver:** Unknown Woman  
**Requirements:** Chapters 2-6    
**Reward:** Honor

*You can also return to this location in the Epilogue to find Arthur's name on the plaque if you donated.*

locations.title: All That Glitters - Jack Hall Gang Treasure Hunt
locations.description:
**Quest Giver**: Máximo Cristóbal Valdespino

**Region**: South-West of [Horseshoe Overlook Camp](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=35)

**Requirements**: None

**Reward:**  2 Gold Bars (each worth $500)

Purchase the map from Maximo for $10, reject his offer to haggle it down to $5, or steal it. If you miss the opportunity, it can be purchased from a Fence later.

Once the map is collected, the Jack Hall Gang Treasure Hunt begins - and continues [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=37).

locations.title: A Fine Night For It
locations.description:
**Quest Giver:** Old Cajun  
**Requirements:** Chapter 2, At least 1 Nite Folk encounter  
**Availability:** Night (between 10PM – 5AM)  

Before the mission can be triggered, the player must have an encounter with the Nite Folk of the Bayou at least once. They can be found as random encounters in the swamps around Saint Denis, more commonly at night.

locations.title: The Veteran

locations.description:
This is your campsite between "The Wheel" and "The Landowning Classes" in Epilogue, Part I.

**NB:** Pronghorn Ranch will only exist after completing Chapter 6.

locations.title: Snowfield Shack Cheat Code
locations.description:
Etched into a drawer in the shack is the cheat code "You flourish before you die".

This cheat increases your Health, Stamina, and Dead Eye bars to be full.

locations.title: Deer Cottage Cheat Code
locations.description:
The cheat code "You want more than you have" is etched into the top drawer of a dresser in the [Deer Cottage](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=30360).

This cheat spawns a superior horse in front of you.

locations.title: Ambarino Sign Cheat Code
locations.description:
On the wooden train track supports you'll see the cheat code "Make Me Better" etched into a plank forming the large 'R'. 

This cheat increases your Dead Eye proficiency to level 2. Activating Dead Eye level 2 will allow you to manually mark targets with Dead Eye.

locations.title: Red Wagon Cheat Code
locations.description:
The cheat code "You want everyone to go away" is etched into the wagon.

This cheat removes any bounties you have accrued and ends any lockdowns you have triggered.

locations.title: Vetter's Echo Cheat Code
locations.description:
Take the [Black Widow Spider](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=744) cigarette card and search the desk drawers beneath it to find "You Want Punishment" carved into the top drawer.

This cheat increases your wanted level.

locations.title: Cairn Lake Cheat Code
locations.description:
The cheat code "Keep your dreams simple" is carved into the ice.

This cheat spawns a wagon in front of you.

locations.title: Two Crows Cheat Code
locations.description:
The cheat code "The best of the old ways" is carved into the wood inside the shack.

This cheat spawns a stagecoach in front of you.

locations.title: Dilapidated House Cheat Code
locations.description:
Go inside the shack to find the code "You want something new".

This cheat spawns a random horse in front of you.

locations.title: Fort Riggs Cheat Code
locations.description:
Inside the building you will find "RUN! RUN! RUN!" written on the chalkboard.

This cheat spawns a race horse in front of you.

locations.title: Lannahechee Shipwreck Cheat Code
locations.description:
The cheat code "Better than my dog" is etched into the ship.

This cheat increases your whistle range, allowing your horse to find you no matter how far away you are.

locations.title: Millesani Cheat Code
locations.description:
The cheat code "A fool on command" can be found inside the mine, hidden in a corner and written in red.

This cheat will instantly make you drunk.

locations.title: Rio Bravo Island Cheat Code
locations.description:
"My kingdom is a horse" is etched into a rock on this island.

This cheat increases your bonding with all horses that you own.

locations.title: Houseboat Cheat Code
locations.description:
Climb over to the end of the little boathouse and find the code "Seek all the bounty of this place"

This cheat increases your Health, Stamina, and Dead Eye bar levels.

locations.title: Cattail Cheat Code
locations.description:
Go inside the railway tunnel to find the cheat code "I seek and I find".

This cheat increases your Dead Eye proficiency to level 5. Activating Dead Eye level 5 will highlight critical areas in addition to fatal areas while in Dead Eye.

locations.title: Owanjila Cheat Code
locations.description:
Under the Owanjila Dam is the cheat code "I still seek more".

This cheat increases your Dead Eye proficiency to level 4. Activating Dead Eye level 4 will highlight fatal areas while in Dead Eye.

locations.title: Clemens Cove Shipwreck Cheat Code
locations.description:
On the front of the shipwreck you can find the cheat code "I shall be better".

This cheat increases your Dead Eye proficiency to level 3. Activating Dead Eye level 3 will allow you to remain in Dead Eye after firing your weapon.

locations.title: Sunken Boat Cheat Code
locations.description:
In the cabin of the sunken boat is the cheat code "Be greedy only for foresight". 

This cheat allows the use of Infinite Dead Eye.

locations.title: Lookout Tower Cheat Code
locations.description:
The cheat code "Balance. All is balance" can be found at the top of the tower facing east. It's etched into the top board of the half-wall.

This cheat resets your Honor to absolute neutrality.

locations.title: Barnhouse Cheat Code
locations.description:
On the upper floor of the barnhouse is the cheat code "You revel in your disgrace, I see".

This cheat decreases your Honor level to its lowest possible value.

locations.title: Bacchus Cave Cheat Code
locations.description:
Inside this small cave is the cheat code "Greed is now a virtue".

This cheat gives you $500 every time it is activated.

locations.title: Caretaker House Cheat Code
locations.description:
Open the drawer in the shack to find the cheat code "A simple life, a beautiful death".

This cheat grants access to a loadout of basic weapons.

locations.title: Cornwall K&T Cheat Code
locations.description:
The cheat code "Keep your dreams light" is carved into the top right drawer of a desk on the bottom floor.

This cheat spawns a buggy in front of you, as seen in the screenshot.

locations.title: Pink Wagon Cheat Code
locations.description:
The cheat code "Guide me better" is etched into the wagon.

This cheat increases your deadeye proficiency to level 1. Activating Dead Eye level 1 will set your Dead Eye to automatically mark targets.

locations.title: Lake Don Julio House Cheat Code
locations.description:
Cheat code “Eat of knowledge” is etched into the wall above the door inside the house.

This cheat grants access to all crafting recipes.

locations.title: Fence's Shop Cheat Code
locations.description:
Inside the [Fence's shop](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=19), you can find the cheat code "Vanity. All is Vanity" etched into the top drawer of the first cabinet to your right.

This cheat grants access to all outfits.

locations.title: Pleasance House Cheat Code
locations.description:
Inside [Pleasance House](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=30404) there is a chest with the cheat code "Share" etched into it.

This cheat increases the camp's supply levels to their maximum and unlocks all camp upgrades.

locations.title: Trading Post Cheat Code
locations.description:
Go inside the shack and look at the ceiling to find the cheat code "History is written by fools".

This cheat grants access to a loadout of gunslinger weapons.

locations.title: Adler Ranch Cheat Code
locations.description:
On the support beam of the burnt remains of the main house is the code "Death Is Silence"

This cheat grants access to a loadout of stealth weapons.

locations.title: Benedict Pass Cheat Code
locations.description:
The cheat code "You want freedom" is found carved under the bridge.

This cheat decreases your wanted level.

locations.title: Newspaper Cheat Code I (Chapter 1)
locations.description:
Purchase a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=46) (New Hanover Gazette No. 27) during Chapter 1 to find the cheat code "Abundance is the dullest desire".

This cheat code grants the use of unlimited ammo, but can only be activated if you read the newspaper.

locations.title: Newspaper Cheat Code II (Chapter 3)
locations.description:
Purchase a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=33) (Saint Denis Times #46) after the Chapter 3 mission 'Advertising, The Old American Art' to find the cheat code "Greed is American Virtue".

This cheat code grants access to a loadout of heavy weapons, but can only be activated if you read the newspaper.

locations.title: Newspaper Cheat Code III (Chapter 3)
locations.description:
Purchase a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=46) (New Hanover Gazette #31) after the Chapter 3 mission 'Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern' to find the cheat code "You long for sight and see nothing".

This cheat code removes all fog from the world map.

locations.title: Newspaper Cheat Code IV (Chapter 4)
locations.description:
Purchase a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=128) (Blackwater Ledger #67) after the Chapter 4 mission 'Urban Pleasures' to find the cheat code "Virtue unearned is not virtue".

This cheat code increases your Honor level to its highest possible value, but can only be activated if you read the newspaper.

locations.title: Newspaper Cheat Code V (Chapter 5)
locations.description:
Purchase a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=128) (Blackwater Ledger #68) after returning from Guarma in Chapter 5 to find the cheat code "The lucky be strong evermore".

This cheat code allows the use of infinite stamina, but can only be activated if you read the newspaper.

locations.title: Newspaper Cheat Code VI (Chapter 6)
locations.description:
Purchase a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=2245) (New Hanover Gazette #36) after the Chapter 6 mission 'The King's Son' to find the cheat code "You seek more than the world offers".

This cheat code refills and fortifies your health, stamina, and Dead Eye, but can only be activated if you read the newspaper.

locations.title: Newspaper Cheat Code VII (Epilogue 1)
locations.description:
Purchase a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=128) (Blackwater Ledger #72) after the Epilogue Part 1 mission 'The Wheel' to find the cheat code "You are a beast built for war".

This cheat code spawns a war horse in front of you, but can only be activated if you read the newspaper.

locations.title: Newspaper Cheat Code VIII (Epilogue 1)
locations.description:
Purchase a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=2248) (The Blackwater Ledger #73) after the Epilogue 1 mission 'The Landowning Classes' to find the cheat code "Would you be happier as a clown?"

This cheat code spawns a circus wagon in front of you, but can only be activated if you read the newspaper.

locations.title: UFO
locations.description: Inspect the Mysterious Sermon found inside the shack.  You'll then need to return at 2am and look up through the roof to see the UFO. It will disappear when you step outside.

locations.title: Massive Dead Snake
locations.description: A large snake can be found dead in the branches of a tree here.

locations.title: Witch's Cauldron
locations.description: A cauldron filled with an unknown liquid. Drinking it will result in the a black-out, before waking up several yards away with all cores restored to maximum.

locations.title: Robot
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Complete chapter 4 mission "Joys of Civilization", Complete Marko Dragic stranger missions

If you're using the [Electric Lantern](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=25042), it will glow red/orange as you get closer to the robot

locations.title: Conversation with a Giant - Starting Point
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Study at least 30 animals

When you arrive at the location on a **clear day** (not rainy, stormy, snowy or foggy), a flock of birds will take off from the shore.  Follow them until you reach an [inaccessible cave](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=927#L). A conversation with a kind-hearted giant will automatically start.

You can have a second conversation if you return 3 days later, and two more in the Epilogue.

locations.title: Ghost Train
locations.description: Spawns on this stretch of tracks, generally in the middle of the night or around 3AM.

locations.title: Deformed Singer
locations.description: On the porch, playing a banjo

locations.title: Vampire
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Find the 5 vampire clues: [#1](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=875), [#2](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=876), [#3](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=877), [#4](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=878), [#5](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=879) 

After finding the 5 clues, you'll find a vampire here finishing off his latest victim.  If you kill him, you'll receive an Ornate Dagger

**Note:** You have to come at night, and he may not always spawn. Appears between 00:00 and 01:00.

**Tip:** If you kill him and are unable to find the dagger then it will be available at the Fence.

locations.title: Conversation with a Giant - Cave
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Study at least 30 animals 

After following [this flock of birds](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=730#L), this is the cave where the Giant can be encountered (but not seen).

You can have a second conversation if you return 3 days later, and two more in the Epilogue.

locations.title: Mexico Glitch
locations.description:
**Requirements:** Max horse stamina, stamina + health stimulants & revivers.

**Note:** Save before attempting this glitch.

First, you need to cross the river at the narrowest point, opposite this marker.  Your horse will need stamina + health stimulants to stay alive during this.

Then, head for this marked location.  You need to run your horse into the end of the canyon, and attempt to glitch yourself up to the top ledge (you can use cheats if your horse dies - but make sure you save before doing this).

Eventually you'll be able to glitch yourself up on top of the canyon and explore all of Mexico.

locations.title: Glowing Pentagram
locations.description: A red glowing pentagram appears below a small shack here between 4am and 5am

locations.title: Whiskey Tree
locations.description:
One of the bottles hanging on this tree contains a gold nugget.  Use Eagle Eye to highlight the correct bottle and shoot it to retrieve the gold nugget.

There is also a Ginseng Elixir in the center of the tree

locations.title: Sheep Lover
locations.description: You'll find a [Gold Wedding Ring](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=369) tied to his "wife"

locations.title: Josiah Trelawny's House
locations.description: Head up the stairs here to listen to a conversation inside the Trelawny home. If you wait around for long enough, Arthur will call out to him and have a brief chat.

locations.title: Missing Princess Poster
locations.description: On the outside wall of the saloon. A poster offering a reward for the missing _Princess Isabeau Katharina Zinsmeister_

locations.title: Manzanita Post Mystery
locations.description:
This area is home to a small group of Norwegian immigrants. You can find 3 items for this mystery:

- **Norwegian Journal Page** - inside the chimney of the small cabin.  
- **Norwegian Photo** - found under a loose floorboard.  
- **Norwegian Newspaper Scrap** - looted from the husband.  

By translating these items you can uncover a dark secret about the people here.

locations.title: Alchemist's House
locations.description: When you approach this house for the first time, you'll witness the alchemist's final experiment!

locations.title: The Whispering Forest
locations.description:
Walk through the forest during a fog, and you'll hear 2 voices whispering.

If you go to a theatre and watch "The Ghastly Serenade", you can learn the story of these voices

locations.title: Taxidermy Gorilla
locations.description: Hidden away on the steep slopes of the Big Valley mountains, just northwest of Wallace Station, lies a life-sized gorilla statue that looks as if it fell right out of a circus cargo.

locations.title: Frozen Cattle Drive
locations.description: A herd of cattle frozen in the snow from a failed drive.

locations.title: Well
locations.description: At the bottom of the well in front of the repossessed house, there's 4 quarters and a number of carved tally marks and crosses in the wall - suggesting someone was kept down there against their will.

locations.title: Strange Man Portrait
locations.description: There is a portrait of the Strange Man behind Herbert Moon in the General Store.

locations.title: UFO #2
locations.description: After finding the mysterious sermon and seeing the [first UFO](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=181) at [Hani's Bethel](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=190), come to the peak of Mount Shann and wait until around midnight / 1AM / 2AM for a second glimpse at life beyond the stars.

locations.title: Rock Painting #1
locations.description: **Note: Unrelated to the rock carving collectibles.**

locations.title: Rock Painting #2
locations.description:
On the side of a boulder, facing south

**Note: Unrelated to the rock carving collectibles.**

locations.title: Rock Painting #3
locations.description: **Note: Unrelated to the rock carving collectibles.**

locations.title: Rock Painting #4
locations.description: **Note: Unrelated to the rock carving collectibles.**

locations.title: Leader X Tree
locations.description: A tree with strange markings that can only be spotted from a distance.

locations.title: Shallow Grave
locations.description: You'll find yourself here after a few drinks at [Aberdeen Pig Farm](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=109), and can bring the woman that lives at the pig farm here to get some extra dialogue.

locations.title: Severed Arm
locations.description:
You can catch a severed arm while fishing near the mayor's house.

*Note: Will only appear if you opted to kill Jean-Marc at the end of [Idealism and Pragmatism for Beginners](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=391) III*

locations.title: Pagan Symbols on a Tree (1/3)
locations.description: Carved into a tree north-west of the [Tiny Church](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=356).

locations.title: Pagan Ritual Painting
locations.description: Enter the [Devil's Cave](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=899), cross the bridge and follow the tunnel to the right. The painting is on the left wall just before reaching the room with the ladder.

locations.title: New Hanover Rock Arrangement
locations.description: Just off the path you'll see "New Hanover" spelled out with rocks on the side of the hill.

locations.title: Rains Fall
locations.description:
***Epilogue Only***

Rains Fall can be encountered in the train station here during the epilogue.

locations.title: Meteor Shower
locations.description: At around 2:30 - 3 AM, in the field near the [Meteor House](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=152) - you can see a meteor shower if the sky is clear. The spot is easiest to reach when approaching from the south-west.

locations.title: Joshua Burgess
locations.description:
This gravestone represents an interesting story that is told through a letter found elsewhere on the map, in a wrecked mail truck.

The gravestone reads "Joshua Burgess Accidentally shot August 1898". The shooting occurred less than a year before the beginning of the story. The story in the letter tells of a relationship between the daughter of the man who owns Emerald Ranch and a young man. 

The ranch owner did not approve of the relationship and shot the young man in the saloon which still has blood on the floor and bullet holes in the walls where the shooting occurred.

locations.title: Miriam Wegner
locations.description: Miriam can be seen looking out of the upstairs window around midnight and noon.

locations.title: Workers' Gravestone
locations.description: A single wooden headstone inscribed with the "names" of workers who died while building the railroad. Small piles of clothing can be found nearby.

locations.title: El Presidio
locations.description:
Look across the river to spot this iconic fort that served as a stronghold for the Mexican army in the first Red Dead Redemption.

Cannot be reached without the use of the [Mexico Glitch](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=966)

locations.title: Precarious Wagon
locations.description: A wagon teeters on the edge of a cliff. If you climb inside, you will immediately slip forward and fall to your death. As if that wasn't enough, the game dramatically zooms in as it happens.

locations.title: "Why" Trees
locations.description: Several burned and shattered trees, presumably hit by lightning, can be found here. If you stand at a specific angle, they spell the word "WHY".

locations.title: Pagan Grave
locations.description: A pagan grave with a skull tombstone

locations.title: Pagan Symbols on a Tree 3/3
locations.description: Directly east of the [Tiny Church](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=356), near an Acuna's Star Orchid.

locations.title: Hanging Man & Hearse
locations.description: A hearse was seemingly attacked here, with the coffin it was carrying laying open. The driver, or perhaps the corpse he was transporting, is hanging from the vehicle.

locations.title: Legendary Channel Catfish
locations.description:
**Note:** The Legendary Channel Catfish is not obtainable and was only mentioned when Jeremy Gill tried to catch it during _"A Fisher of Fish II"_.

_After you complete the mission, The Legendary Channel Catfish becomes visible on the map like any other legendary fish, but still cannot be caught._

locations.title: Bayonet in Tree
locations.description: 50 paces from the Southeast corner of the old Bolger Glade Church - a rifle / bayonet is stuck in the tree

locations.title: Ghosts of Bolger Glade
locations.description: Come here during a stormy night to hear ghostly whispers from General Harris & his men during the Battle of Scarlett Meadows of 1864.

locations.title: Pan Tree
locations.description: A bunch of pots and pans are stuck to this tree.

locations.title: Tilly Jackson
locations.description:
***Epilogue Only***

Tilly can be encountered in the park here during the second part of the epilogue.

locations.title: Greta Van Der Linde
locations.description: The final resting place of Dutch's mother can be found here, beside a tree on the middle row.

locations.title: Chain Gang
locations.description: A group of skeletons in prisoner clothing can be found in the woods here. It seems one of them removed his foot to escape the chains, but he couldn't escape the reaper.

locations.title: Cave Painting
locations.description: Inside Elysian Cave

locations.title: Shiver Me Timbers
locations.description: Underneath the bridge, the corpse of a pirate can be found with an unburied chest. You can also find a long-dead dead alligator next to him, and loot the chest for [Bitters & Money](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=841)

locations.title: A Cowboy of No Name
locations.description:
Grave marker for a "Cowboy of No Name" - referencing the "Man With No Name" from _The Good, the Bad and the Ugly_.

The same grave can also be found in the [first game.](https://mapgenie.io/red-dead-redemption/maps/world?locationIds=294302)

locations.title: Simon Pearson
locations.description:
***Epilogue Only***

Pearson can be found inside the [General Store](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=27) during the epilogue.

locations.title: Boat in Tree
locations.description: A boat can be found in a tree here, with chains holding it together.

locations.title: Mary-Beth Gaskill
locations.description: ***Epilogue Only***

locations.title: Lillie <3 Alfred
locations.description:
Carved into a tree just north of Flatneck Station, a few yards past the road.

Lillie adds a few more lines in the epilogue.

locations.title: Thirsty Work
locations.description: The corpses here are holding dowsing rods, implying that they died of dehydration.

locations.title: Potbelly Stove
locations.description: Next to the trail, amongst some trees and shrubbery.

locations.title: Caliban's Seat
locations.description: On the northern side of the hill you can find [Valerian Root](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=63932) in an old, unoccupied camp.

locations.title: Two Crows
locations.description: Bears a striking resemblance to a location in Red Dead Revolver

locations.title: Evelyn Miller Camp
locations.description: Note: Unlocked after "The American Inferno, Burnt Out II".

locations.title: Fort Riggs
locations.description:
An abandoned fort that was once used by the US Army as a holding area for captured Native Americans. The story of the fort is told by a drunk army veteran during a random stranger encounter.

A letter can be found in the main building that appears to be practice for the correct spelling of various english words. If you write down the first letter of each word a secret poem is revealed.

locations.title: Siltwater Strand
locations.description: May only appear on the map when you approach it from the other side of the river.

locations.title: Ewing Basin
locations.description: Money clip can be found in a nightstand drawer; several cigars and ammo can be found throughout the shacks

locations.title: The Loft
locations.description: The basement in back is full of ammunition and there are a number of containers inside, including a chest with a gold watch.

locations.title: Carmody Dell
locations.description: A great place to "hunt" cows and bulls - just don't get caught!

locations.title: Micah's Hideout
locations.description: Added to the map during the American Venom mission in Epilogue 2.

locations.title: Gaptooth Breach
locations.description: Home to a [Gang Hideout](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=21247).

locations.title: Solomon's Folly
locations.description: Home to a [Gang Hideout.](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=21248)

locations.title: Beecher's Hope
locations.description: Added to the map (and can be used as a [fast travel point](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=1990)) after the "Home on the Gentry" mission in the Epilogue.

locations.title: Hanging Dog Ranch
locations.description: Home to a [Gang Hideout.](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=402)

locations.title: Serial Killer Clue
locations.description:
**Murder Scene:** A dismembered body is strung up under a bridge. On a stake nearby you'll find a head that has "Killer Clue 1 Piece" in its mouth. You can also shoot the body down.

**Mission Unlocked:** Finding all 3 clues unlocks the [American Dreams](https://rdr2map.com/?locationIds=320) stranger mission.

locations.title: Serial Killer Clue
locations.description:
**Murder Scene:** This body is tied to a large tree. At the base of the tree, you'll find a head on a stake, with a "Serial Killer Piece" in its mouth. There are 3 clues in total. The number of the clue is determined by the order in which you find them.

**Mission Unlocked:** Finding all 3 clues unlocks the [American Dreams](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=320) stranger mission.

locations.title: Serial Killer Clue
locations.description:
**Murder Scene:** This body is tied to a large tree. At the base of the tree, you'll find a head on a stake, with a "Serial Killer Piece" in its mouth. There are 3 clues in total. The number of the clue is determined by the order in which you find them.

**Mission Unlocked:** Finding all 3 clues unlocks the _American Dreams_ stranger mission.

locations.title: Vampire Clue - #1
locations.description: The clue is at ground level, on the wall on the corner of the building. You'll see white writing which you need to examine to begin the investigation.

locations.title: Vampire Clue - #2
locations.description: Just before you enter the market, look to the right of the arch, and you'll see an area with some railings and a metal gate.  The clue is here, on the wall on the left (beside some barrels).

locations.title: Vampire Clue - #3
locations.description: Between the General Store and the Butcher's. The writing is on the wall facing the train tracks to the south.

locations.title: Vampire Clue - #4
locations.description: From the garden with a tree in the middle, go through the archway that's furthest to the right. There, you'll find the writing above a chair, on the corner.

locations.title: Vampire Clue - #5
locations.description: On a wall under the arches.  This clue is slightly difficult to spot, due to the shadows.

locations.title: Panoramic Map POV
locations.description: This is the exact spot depicted in the [Panoramic Map](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=1997). There's also a sundial nearby.

locations.title: Cougar's Den
locations.description: Not a reliable place to find cougars, oddly enough.

locations.title: Micah's Camp
locations.description:
**Availability:** After completing _An American Pastoral Scene_.

Here you will find some old newspaper clippings and documents that Micah has stashed.

locations.title: Burnt-out Wagon
locations.description: A burnt-out wagon, team of oxen, and two bodies.

locations.title: Sitting Spot
locations.description: You can sit on the edge of a small platform with stilts.

locations.title: Sitting Spot
locations.description: On the cliff's lower level.

locations.title: Sitting Spot
locations.description: Overlooking the river.

locations.title: Sitting Spot
locations.description: Near the end of the dock.

locations.title: Sitting Spot
locations.description: On the edge of the cliff, at the back of the camp.

locations.title: Sitting Spot
locations.description: On the edge of the cliff, at the back of the camp.

locations.title: Sitting Spot
locations.description: On top of the first houseboat facing the water

locations.title: Sitting Spot
locations.description: On the plank of the music-playing houseboat.

locations.title: Sitting Spot
locations.description: On the second level of Fort Brennand, overlooking the inside of the fort.

locations.title: Sitting Spot
locations.description: At the end of the dock

locations.title: Sitting Spot
locations.description: On the edge of the cliff.

locations.title: Sitting Spot
locations.description: Overlooking the lake, next to the nest

locations.title: Sitting Spot
locations.description: On a ledge near the [Nevada Hat](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=141)

locations.title: Absinthe - Cycle 1
locations.description: Inside the burnt broken wagon furthest from the shack

locations.title: Absinthe - Cycle 2
locations.description: Inside the mausoleum

locations.title: Absinthe - Cycle 3
locations.description: In the cabinet inside the hut

locations.title: Caribbean Rum - Cycle 1
locations.description: Inside the build to the left near the entrance.

locations.title: Caribbean Rum - Cycle 2
locations.description: By a stranger mission, beside a tent on the ground.

locations.title: Caribbean Rum - Cycle 3
locations.description: On the table.

locations.title: Cognac - Cycle 1
locations.description: Through the window - directly to your right in the cabinet.

locations.title: Cognac - Cycle 2
locations.description: In the broken building, inside of a metal barrel.

locations.title: Cognac - Cycle 3
locations.description: In the desk

locations.title: Gran Corazon Madeira - Cycle 1
locations.description: Where the trapper is, on top of a small wooden crate.

locations.title: Gran Corazon Madeira - Cycle 2
locations.description: Under the broken wagon

locations.title: Gran Corazon Madeira - Cycle 3
locations.description: Ground floor - in the cabinet in the left corner when you enter.

locations.title: Irish Whiskey - Cycle 1
locations.description: Go in an alley way across from the Barber's place. Go up the ladder and follow the pathway on the balconies and it'll be between two creaked-open doors.

locations.title: Irish Whiskey - Cycle 2
locations.description: In the tree house, on top of the table.

locations.title: Irish Whiskey - Cycle 3
locations.description: On the table inside the house

locations.title: London Dry Gin - Cycle 1
locations.description: Inside Braithwaite Manor on the edge of the large-stretched dining table.

locations.title: London Dry Gin - Cycle 2
locations.description: Inside of the tree trunk.

locations.title: London Dry Gin - Cycle 3
locations.description: On a barrel at the top of the stairs of the lighthouse

locations.title: Old Tom Gin - Cycle 1
locations.description: In the hole of the broken walkway outside the house

locations.title: Old Tom Gin - Cycle 2
locations.description: Inside the building, on the edge of the counter.

locations.title: Old Tom Gin - Cycle 3
locations.description: Under the sink

locations.title: Scotch Whiskey - Cycle 2
locations.description: Inside of a wooden crate next to the water.

locations.title: Scotch Whiskey - Cycle 1
locations.description: Inside the witch-like house - directly to your right on the table.

locations.title: Scotch Whiskey - Cycle 3
locations.description: Second floor, inside the wardrobe.

locations.title: Tennessee Whiskey - Cycle 1
locations.description: Inside the house - on top of the table with the red checkered cloth.

locations.title: Tennessee Whiskey - Cycle 2
locations.description: Inside a small cabin, in the sink cabinet.

locations.title: Tennessee Whiskey - Cycle 3
locations.description: Found in one of the bottom cabinets in the living room.

locations.title: Gran Corazon Madeira - Cycle 4
locations.description: Bottom floor - in the cabinet under the sink.

locations.title: Absinthe - Cycle 4
locations.description: On top of the Wardenclyffe Tower.

locations.title: Tennessee Whiskey - Cycle 4
locations.description: Inside an underground passage. Enter from a building to the north-east.

locations.title: Scotch Whiskey - Cycle 4
locations.description: Found next to chimney of burned down house.

locations.title: Irish Whiskey - Cycle 4
locations.description: Under the back of the wagon

locations.title: Caribbean Rum - Cycle 4
locations.description: Inside a tent on top of a box

locations.title: London Dry Gin - Cycle 4
locations.description: At the top of the tower

locations.title: Cognac - Cycle 4
locations.description: Inside the house - in the cabinet under the sink.

locations.title: Old Tom Gin - Cycle 4
locations.description: Inside shack, on table.

locations.title: Tennessee Whiskey - Cycle 5
locations.description: Under the church's eastern side.
